description:
Quadric has created an innovative general purpose neural processing unit (GPNPU) architecture. Quadric's co\-optimized software and hardware is targeted to run neural network (NN) inference workloads in a wide variety of edge and endpoint devices, ranging from battery operated smart\-sensor systems to high\-performance automotive or autonomous vehicle systems. Unlike other NPUs or neural network accelerators in the industry today that can only accelerate a portion of a machine learning graph, the Quadric GPNPU executes both NN graph code and conventional C\+\+ DSP and control code.
   

  

**Role** 




 The AI Kernel Engineer in Quadric plays the key role to enable a large number of AI kernels/operators to run efficiently on the Quadric platform. The AI Kernel Engineer at Quadric will \[1] develop a highly efficient Quadric kernel library for a variety of AI/LLM models; \[2] analyze the performance and optimize the kernel for different hardware configurations; This senior technical role demands deep knowledge of hardware architecture, compiler toolchain and optimization techniques.
 



  

**Responsibilities** 



* Develop AI/LLM kernels/operators on Quadric platform for efficient inference
* Optimize the kernel performance for different hardware configurations and workloads
* Profile and analyze kernel performance in terms of compute, data and parallelism; identify micro\-architecture and software bottlenecks and provide optimization solutions
* Optimize kernel C/C\+\+ codes, maximize hardware utilization
* Collaborate across related areas of the AI inference stack to support team and business priorities
* Make Improvement to Quadric toolchain, compiler and runtime
* Provide technical support and documents to customers and developer community


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science and/or Electric Engineering
* 5\+ years of experience in AI kernel development and optimization
* experience with model and kernel inference performance profiling
* experience with at least one of the following compute development: CUDA, DSP, NEON, Triton\-lang
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ and Python, experience with assembly language a plus
* Demonstrate good capability in problem solving, debug and communication


**Benefits**
* Provide competitive salaries and meaningful equity
* Provide a politics free community for the brilliant minds who want to make an immediate impact
* Provide an opportunity for you to build long term career relationships
* Foster an environment that allows for lasting personal relationships alongside professional one



 Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real\-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co\-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co\-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21\.
   





*Quadric is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability or any.*




*By submitting an application, you acknowledge that Quadric will collect and process your personal information as part of the hiring process. Please review our* 
*Privacy Policy* 
*to understand how we handle your data.*

description:
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid\-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
   

  

 At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by
 **our commitment to empowering our employees around the world** 
 .
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic, personable, and qualified Senior Network Operation Center Engineer (Network Monitoring) to join our amazing team! In this role, you will be part of the Network Services Team (NOC) that provides 24x7 monitoring, operations, and support services.
   

  

 The Senior NOC Engineer – Network Monitoring will provide monitoring and troubleshooting of
 **network infrastructure devices** 
 for global customers, supporting LAN/WAN/Firewalls /SD\-WAN environments. While responding to Level 1 and 2 service tickets, you will work closely with the team to address complex network problems escalated by NOC engineers. You will be responsible for escalating issues to next\-level support and engaging third\-party vendors for any
 **network or connectivity impairments** 
 .
   

  

 This is an
 **onsite** 
 role.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Resolve level 1 and 2 network support cases, incidents, and work orders associated with routing, switching, WAN, SD\-WAN and firewall environments following ECI defined SLAs.
* Set client expectations appropriately throughout the troubleshooting process, ensuring clear communication.
* Resolve incidents and requests from centralized monitoring systems related to, but not limited to the following:
* Alarm validation and alert correlation
* Routing protocol (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and switching issues (VLAN, STP)
* WAN/MPLS/VPLS/Express Route/Internet circuit issues
* SD\-WAN related alerts (tunnel status, edge device health, policy issues)
* Connectivity issues, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization
* Firewall issues (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet — NAT, policies, sessions)
* Wireless network\-related issues (controllers, AP connectivity)
* Perform troubleshooting, problem analysis, and isolation of network events in accordance with incident management guidelines.
* Follow ECI change control process for performing changes such as PAN\-OS, IOS and Meraki upgrades, configuration changes, and SD\-WAN updates during approved maintenance windows.
* Incident Management via ServiceNow tool.
* Follow client escalation procedures and handle customer calls for diagnosing network\-related issues.
* Provide timely and accurate end\-to\-end support via phone, email, and ticketing documentation.
* Accurately document incidents, diagnostics, correlations, and resolutions in the ticketing system.
* Maintain WAN links and engage ISPs and vendors for circuit outages, latency, packet loss or bandwidth issues.
* Escalate outage events and network impairments to appropriate stakeholders when unresolved within SLA timelines.
* Monitor and track scheduled network maintenance activities, analyzing impact and ensuring alignment with approved windows.
* Coordinate with internal teams and respond to communications promptly.
* Act as an escalation point for NOC Engineers on network related issues.
* Produce reports such as RCA, investigation reports, and network health summaries.
* Provide training for new hires in lower roles on network troubleshooting and monitoring.
* Provide feedback for continuous improvement of NOC network operations.
* Ability to work on Major Incident Management (MIM) tickets (P1/P2\) for Network related issues.


**Who you are:**
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology/computer science or related field.
* 5 years of relevant experience in network support \& monitoring.
* Minimum 2 years as a NOC Engineer in network operations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical network issues clearly.
* Strong prioritization and customer centric mindset.
* Strong troubleshooting skills: ability to identify and analyze network issues, traffic behavior and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to multitask in a high\-volume NOC environment.
* Ability to prioritize tasks in high\-pressure situations.
* Highly self\-motivated and proactive.
* Willingness to work in 24x7x365 operational environment.
* Strong experience in configuration, management, and monitoring of:
* Routers and switches (Cisco or equivalent)
* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet)
* Wireless LAN controllers and access networks
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals
* Experience with routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
* Experience with switching technologies: VLANs, STP, trunking
* Experience in WAN technologies: MPLS, Internet circuits, VPNs (IPSec, SSL)
* Hands\-on experience with SD\-WAN technologies and Firewalls such as:
* Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela) / VMware (Velocloud) / Fortinet / Palo Alto
* Monitoring tools such as LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, or similar SNMP\-based platforms
* Ticketing tools experience such as ServiceNow
* Basic packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark – preferred)
* Certifications/Training Recommendations: CCENT or CCNA or CCNP or PCNSE or training equivalent. Knowledge of TCP/IP, Cisco routing, switching technologies and ITIL Exposure


**Bonus points if you have:**
* Experience with Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM
* Experience with network monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, ConnectWise Automate etc.)
* Knowledge of DNS and network\-related services
* Relevant advanced network certifications


 ECI’s culture is all about connection – connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and so much more! If you believe you would be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever,
 **we would like to hear from you!**
**Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!**

Technical Lead, IT Infrastructure

**Summary**
 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented RDL Network Administrator to manage the day\-to\-day operations and administration of our global Research and Development Lab (RDL) networks. Reporting directly to the Lead Network Architect, you will be responsible for the run\-and\-maintain aspects of our isolated, air\-gapped networks across multiple HPS Design Center locations (including San Jose, Richardson, Thailand, Shanghai, SongShan Lake, Penang, Chennai, and future sites).
   

  

 This role uniquely focuses on cutting\-edge open networking. The majority of our RDL network infrastructure runs on SONiC (Software for Open Networking in the Cloud) deployed on Celestica’s own high\-performance network switches. Furthermore, security inside the air\-gap relies heavily on Zscaler technology acting as internal firewalls integrated with local VLANs for precise, policy\-driven access control.
   

  

 Since this environment operates under strict security isolation without typical enterprise automated management tools, this role requires a hands\-on, highly disciplined administrator who excels at executing manual and semi\-automated workflows securely and consistently. Traditional Cisco\-based networking skills are considered secondary to expertise in SONiC, Linux networking, and Zscaler\-driven zero\-trust security.
   

  

 This role requires regular on\-site presence within the RDL environment and participation in a 24x7 on\-call rotation supporting global RDL infrastructure, including after\-hours incident response and scheduled maintenance activities.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* SONiC \& Open Network Operations
* SONiC Infrastructure Management: Monitor, configure, and maintain the health, performance, and uptime of Celestica’s proprietary open network switches running the SONiC operating system.
* Configuration \& Segmentation: Implement localized VLAN adjustments, IP address allocations, and switch port provisioning within the SONiC environment to isolate multi\-tenant engineering projects.
* Routine Maintenance: Execute hardware diagnostics, physical cabling checks, and SONiC OS/firmware updates following strict maintenance window guidelines.
* Secondary Infrastructure Support: Perform operational support, troubleshooting, and maintenance of legacy secondary network components, including Check Point 3980 firewalls, Silver Peak SD\-WAN appliances, and Cisco Catalyst 9400/9200 switches as required.
* Zscaler \& Internal Security Policy Administration
* Zero\-Trust Internal Firewalling: Administer and configure Zscaler ZTNA / App Connectors to serve as internal firewalls, establishing secure boundaries and controlling data flow across isolated local VLANs.
* Access Control \& Identity: Provision local user accounts, configure role\-based permissions, and manage decentralized credentials on Linux\-based jump hosts.
* Remote Session Security: Manage secure engineer connections using CyberArk vPAM (Virtual Privileged Access Management).
* Security Auditing: Conduct weekly audits of active user sessions, ACL configurations, and local accounts to maintain an uncompromising security posture.
* Data Transfer \& Repository Sync Operations
* Multi\-Tier Sync Execution: Execute and monitor the secure transfer of "transfer bundles" containing OS packages (Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, CentOS, etc.), drivers, and software libraries across the physical air gap.
* Repository Services Administration: Ensure repository services remain operational, synchronized, and accessible to authorized systems within segmented and isolated RDL environments.
* Integrity Validation: Verify cryptographic hashes (SHA\-256 checksums) of all data packages moving from the Global Repository Server to the RDL Local Repository Server.
* Support Ticket Resolution \& SLA Adherence
* End\-User Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for HPS design engineers needing open network troubleshooting, VLAN routing resolution, or new package requests.
* Ticketing Operations: Process, update, and resolve secure lab support tickets in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalation Point: Identify complex open\-networking bugs, design deviations, or routing limitations and escalate them directly to the Lead Network Architect.
* Compliance \& Environment Enforcement
* Software Auditing: Conduct regular logical audits of systems within the RDL to ensure strictly banned corporate agents (e.g., CrowdStrike, Threat Locker, Big Fix, ServiceNow Agents, ClearPass NAC) are not installed.
* Asset Tracking: Maintain a flawless inventory of all HPS\-owned assets inside the RDL physical rooms, including servers, switches, wireless access points (Aruba 755\), and connected lab machines.


 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
* Network \& Security Hardware: Practical experience configuring and troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 network environments including VLANs, routing, ACLs, packet capture


 analysis, and protocol troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump.
   

  

* Monitoring \& Visibility: Experience with SNMP\-based monitoring and alerting platforms such as SolarWinds, including device health monitoring, performance analysis, fault


 identification, and capacity trending.
   

  

* Linux System Administration: Mid\-to\-senior level Linux administration experience including user management, shell scripting, package management, service administration,


 repository hosting, and network troubleshooting.
   

  

* Access Tools: Experience working with remote access tools such as Zscaler ZTNA / App Connectors and Privilege Access Management solutions (specifically CyberArk).
* Virtualization Administration: Experience provisioning, maintaining, and troubleshooting virtual machines, clustered hosts, storage resources, and virtual networking within VMware vSphere, Nutanix AHV, and/or Microsoft Hyper\-V environments.
* Air\-Gap Protocols: Working knowledge of secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, SCP, rsync) and security scanning methodologies.


**Preferred Certifications**
* CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)
* Check Point Certified Security Administrator (CCSA)
* CompTIA Security\+ or Linux\+
* CyberArk Certified Trustee or Defender


**Soft Skills \& Working Style**
* High Operational Discipline: Ability to strictly adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) without cutting corners, even during urgent troubleshooting.
* Excellent Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, necessary for translating technical issues to designers and coordinating with corporate security teams.
* Multi\-Tasker: Capable of balancing ticket requests from multiple global labs concurrently while maintaining accurate records.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Network Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in network administration or system administration, preferably managing secure, segmented, or laboratory networks.
* Overall 14\+years of work experience is required.


 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
   

  

 Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. description:
We are looking for a customer\-focused and technically capable Support Engineer to provide product support for complex enterprise software applications.
   

  

 The role involves investigating and resolving customer\-reported functional, configuration, calculation, workflow, integration, database, user\-access, and performance issues. The Support Engineer will work closely with customers and internal teams, including Product Engineering, Cloud Operations, Professional Services, and Customer Success.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have experience supporting configurable enterprise web applications, strong SQL and troubleshooting skills, and excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
* Provide technical and functional product support for customer\-reported incidents and service requests.
* Investigate issues related to application behaviour, calculations, quotations, approvals, workflows, user access, and data processing.
* Troubleshoot application errors, failed transactions, incorrect outputs, integration failures, and performance issues.
* Review application logs, server logs, exception traces, database findings, and integration logs to identify the cause of reported issues.
* Use SQL to validate application data, investigate inconsistencies, and support issue resolution.
* Investigate customer\-specific configurations, business rules, workflows, scripts, extensions, and customizations.
* Troubleshoot integrations with external CRM, ERP, and other enterprise systems, including API, authentication, connectivity, timeout, and data\-mapping issues.
* Reproduce reported issues in internal or customer non\-production environments when possible.
* Determine whether an issue is caused by the application, configuration, customization, customer data, integration, or environment.
* Provide customers with clear investigation updates, workarounds, resolutions, configuration guidance, and validation steps.
* Escalate confirmed software defects to Product Engineering with relevant logs, screenshots, technical findings, business impact, and reproducible steps.
* Collaborate with Cloud Operations and other internal teams on application availability, deployment, infrastructure, and performance\-related issues.
* Support patches, hotfixes, emergency deployments, and post\-deployment validation when required.
* Prepare Root Cause Analysis reports, Knowledge Articles, and internal troubleshooting documentation.
* Monitor assigned cases and ensure timely acknowledgement, investigation, communication, and resolution within applicable service\-level targets.

 The candidate must be willing to work in a shift aligned with European business hours and participate in weekend or on\-call support rotations when required.

* Experience supporting browser\-based enterprise applications.
* Strong SQL skills and experience troubleshooting database\-driven applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting configurable enterprise applications involving workflows, approvals, calculations, transactions, or business rules.
* Understanding of end\-to\-end sales, order, approval, or commercial business processes.
* Experience troubleshooting calculation logic, workflow rules, data validations, user access, and customer\-specific customizations.
* Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM platforms and enterprise integrations.
* Experience supporting cloud\-hosted and customer\-managed enterprise applications.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
* Understanding of ITIL\-based incident, problem, change, and knowledge\-management practices.
* Experience working with geographically distributed Support, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Professional Services teams.


 Communication and Customer\-Service Skills
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

title: Embedded Hardware Validation Engineer
description:
**Your Impact**
 You will be working on sophisticated, industrial, real\-time systems involving embedded hardware and software platforms, automated validation, and simulation of field conditions. This team of engineers develops innovative monitoring systems used for Grid Monitoring, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), and Generation applications in electrical substations and power plants.
   

  

**Here’s Where You’ll Demonstrate Your Proficiencies**
* Validation and verification of embedded systems incorporating ARM\-based processors, microcontrollers, Linux\-based platforms, and analog/digital I/O subsystems.
* Design, development, and execution of test plans for hardware components integrated with firmware and software.
* Development of automated test tools, test frameworks, and simulation environments for hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and system\-level testing.
* Execution of integration testing across hardware, firmware, networking, and application software layers.
* Support for regulatory and compliance testing activities, including CE, UL, IEC, IEEE, EMC, and environmental verification.
* Investigation and root\-cause analysis of complex system issues using electrical test equipment, protocol analysis tools, network monitoring tools, and system logs.
* Collaboration with hardware, firmware, software, and systems engineering teams to ensure robust product validation and long\-term reliability.
* Use of Agile Scrum methodologies to support validation activities, continuous improvement, and product quality initiatives.


**Qualifications**
 The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum four years of industry experience, including at least three years in embedded systems validation, hardware verification, or test automation within a laboratory or production environment.
* Strong understanding of embedded systems, digital and analogue electronics, and electrical engineering principles.
* Experience developing automated test solutions using scripting or programming languages such as Python, C\#, LabVIEW, or similar.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive high\-performance validation strategies.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, interpersonal, and technical communication skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with cabinet wiring, electrical safety, circuit protection, and industrial control systems.
* Hands\-on experience using oscilloscopes, digital multi\-meters (DMMs), signal generators, and other laboratory instrumentation for verification and validation activities.
* Experience with networking equipment, managed Ethernet switches, GPS, PTP, NTP, or other precision timing technologies.
* Experience troubleshooting network communications using packet capture and analysis tools such as Wireshark.
* Experience with industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, and related testing methodologies.
* Experience developing automated test harnesses, regression test systems, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test environments.
* Familiarity with protocol testing tools such as IEC Browser, IED Scout, Modbus Poll, and Modbus Slave.
* Exposure to fault location, digital fault recording (DFR), power quality (PQ), synchrophasor (PMU), condition monitoring, or other grid power system applications.
* Experience with Linux\-based embedded platforms and use of version control tools such as Git.
* Knowledge of serial communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, or RS\-485\.
* Exposure to cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessment, secure communications protocols, or IEC 62443 requirements would be advantageous.

description:
**Overview**
 Radancy is the global leader in talent acquisition software, helping employers attract and hire the right talent through AI\-powered recruiting technology, data\-driven insights, and world\-class candidate experiences. Our platform enables organizations to streamline hiring, strengthen employer branding, and drive measurable recruitment outcomes at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Radancy's Global IT team is looking for a Network Engineer with 6\-10 years of experience to help operate and support our enterprise network across a multi\-site, hybrid\-cloud environment.
   

  

 Based in our Bengaluru office, you will be part of the team responsible for the day\-to\-day operation, availability, and performance of Radancy’s corporate network. This includes office connectivity, routing and switching, Palo Alto firewalls, GlobalProtect VPN services, enterprise wireless infrastructure, and network connectivity between our corporate environment and cloud platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with our Infrastructure Lead and global IT teams to troubleshoot incidents, implement network changes, maintain infrastructure, and reduce dependency on any single network resource. You will also help ensure reliable connectivity for approximately 1,000 employees across offices and remote locations globally.
   

  

 This is a corporate IT infrastructure role. While the position supports network routes and connectivity into AWS environments used by our SaaS platform, it is not responsible for operating or delivering the application platform itself.
   

  

**What does a great Senior Network Engineer do?**
* Administer and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, including implementing approved firewall policy and threat\-prevention changes.
* Support and maintain Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN services for approximately 1,000 employees globally.
* Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot site\-to\-site VPNs and other network connections between offices, data centers, cloud environments, and third parties.
* Monitor network and VPN availability, investigate alerts, and resolve connectivity and performance issues.
* Manage and troubleshoot enterprise routing environments using BGP, OSPF, and core routing and switching technologies.
* Support network connectivity and routing between corporate environments and AWS, Azure, and on\-premises infrastructure.
* Manage AWS networking components relevant to corporate and hybrid connectivity, including VPCs, route tables, subnets, gateways, and related routing.
* Manage Azure networking components, including VNets, subnets, routing, peering, gateways, and related connectivity.
* Support enterprise wireless infrastructure, including Ruckus access points or comparable platforms, wireless design, capacity planning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* Maintain DNS, DHCP, IP address management, and other foundational network services.
* Coordinate with internet service providers, telecommunications providers, network vendors, and other third parties supporting Radancy’s offices and network services.
* Support network infrastructure and connectivity for offices across the United States, Europe, India, and other regions.
* Plan and execute network firmware, software, and configuration updates through established testing, rollout, and change\-management processes.
* Maintain network configuration backups and support restoration or recovery activities when required.
* Support the lifecycle of network hardware, including office deployments, upgrades, replacements, and decommissioning.
* Execute network changes through established change\-management and Change Advisory Board processes.
* Lead or contribute to root\-cause analysis following significant network incidents.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex or high\-severity network issues, coordinating with the Infrastructure Lead and global IT teams as needed.
* Support urgent network and firewall changes during security or operational incidents.
* Maintain current network documentation, topology diagrams, inventories, operating procedures, and recovery documentation.
* Cross\-train with other network and infrastructure resources to improve operational coverage and reduce single points of failure.
* Track and report on network capacity, availability, performance, recurring incidents, and infrastructure lifecycle needs.
* Partner with security, cloud engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and other IT teams to maintain reliable connectivity and implement required network controls.


**Qualifications**
* 6\-10 years of hands\-on enterprise networking experience.
* CCNA certification or equivalent demonstrated networking knowledge and experience.
* Proven operational experience administering and troubleshooting Palo Alto firewalls.
* Strong experience supporting Palo Alto GlobalProtect or a comparable enterprise remote\-access VPN platform.
* Strong experience with site\-to\-site VPNs and hybrid network connectivity.
* Strong knowledge of BGP, OSPF, and enterprise routing and switching, with the ability to troubleshoot complex connectivity issues.
* Experience supporting enterprise wireless infrastructure, with Ruckus experience preferred.
* Experience with network monitoring, alert response, configuration management, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of AWS networking, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, gateways, and hybrid connectivity.
* Working knowledge of Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, routing, peering, and gateways.
* Experience supporting DNS, DHCP, and IP address management.
* Demonstrated discipline in change management, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and technical documentation.
* Ability to work independently on operational issues while collaborating with an Infrastructure Lead on complex architecture and design decisions.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and coordination skills.
* Comfort collaborating with distributed teams across regions and time zones.


**Preferred:**
* CCNP, PCNSE, or comparable advanced networking and firewall expertise.
* Experience with network automation using scripting, Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting corporate networks across multiple countries, regions, and office locations.
* Experience coordinating with telecommunications providers, internet service providers, and network hardware or service vendors.
* Experience supporting network connectivity into SaaS production or other business\-critical cloud environments.
* Experience working in a global corporate IT environment with a combination of office, remote\-user, cloud, and on\-premises infrastructure.

**About NCR Atleos**


NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**Company:** NCR Atleos

**Job Title:** Network Operations L2 Analyst

**Job Location:** Mumbai, India

**Shifts:** Rotational

 **Job Description:**


A Network Operations L2 Analyst plays a crucial role in maintaining and optimizing an organization's network infrastructure. Our company is growing rapidly and is searching for experienced candidates for the position of Network Operations L2 Analyst. While this is our ideal list, we will consider candidates that do not necessarily have all the qualifications but have sufficient experience and talent.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Implement and support of the corporate network infrastructure. Key member of the team responsible for designing and developing scalable and highly available global network architectures to meet the firm’s business needs.
* Participate in the design, setup and configuration of complex L2/L3 switches. Maintain, create and update all network documentation and topology diagrams.
* Support multiple datacenters consisting of Cisco Nexus LAN (L2/L3\), Console switches, ASA firewalls, Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnects, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, Aruba Device and other miscellaneous network appliances.
* Research, evaluate, maintain and perform Cisco IOS code upgrades for a global network infrastructure.
* Leverage multiple network monitoring tools to analyze network traffic patterns to proactively identify performance issues and account for capacity planning.
* Work with multiple vendors routinely for support, feature enhancement and design strategy when required.
* Responsible for managing and maintaining SD Wan networks. Full ownership of all WAN routers, configurations, QoS policies and ensuring stability of the network 24/7\.
* Support manage and maintain all ISP Internet connectivity for the firm from multiple carriers with multiple links in multiple locations.
* Support, manage and maintain network monitoring system for the firm’s global network. This includes network performance monitoring for WAN/LAN links, network nodes, alerting and response, network configuration management and compliance and IP address management.
* Support of the firm’s global wireless infrastructure made up of all Cisco thin AP’s and Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers.
* On a rotating basis, provide after hour coverage to respond to network related issues occurring either before or after support hours.
* When requested, attends IT meetings and scheduled teleconferences.
* Other duties and projects as assigned.
* Opportunity to embrace the position, exposure to the latest technologies and growth potential.
 **Requirements**

* 3 \- 5\+ years related work experience preferably in a professional services environment.
* Experience with Cisco Nexus L2/L3 switching technology.
* Protocols EIGRP, BGP, OSPF, HSRP, IPSEC, VPN, NAT, 802\.1Q, 802\.11, LACP, Spanning\-tree, UDLD, BPDU, HTTP, HTTPS, DHCP, DNS.
* Experience with Cisco 4500, 3850, ASR/ISR routers and Nexus 7K/9K’s.
* Must possess a thorough understanding of Network Infrastructure and security topology. IP telephony a plus
* Knowledge and/or experience configuring and supporting Cisco ASA firewalls. VPN, IPS/IDS and Palo Alto.
* Experience with Cisco wireless technology and LAN controllers. Any prior experience Cisco ACS, Radius, TACACS, Prime or ISE.
* Network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Site24x7\), SNMP, Wireshark.
* Experience with Zscaler and/or F5 load balancers very desirable, web URL filtering is a plus but not required.
* Excellent written, oral and interpersonal communications skills.
* Ability to conduct research into network issues and products as required.
* Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user\-friendly language.
* Highly self\-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.
* Proven analytical and creative problem\-solving abilities.
* Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.
 **Qualification**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science or equivalent streams.
* Cisco certifications in Routing, switching and/or Wireless is an added advantage.
 **Work Environment:**

* This is a full\-time position.
* Candidates must be ready to work 5 days a week from Mumbai office.
* Candidates should be ready to work in rotational schedules / shifts and supporting 24x7 operations.

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

**Innovate in Bengaluru**
 This position is based at our on\-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting\-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on\-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.
   

  

**About Lowe’s**
 Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com
   

  

 Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India
   

  

**About The Team**
 TOC (Technology Operation Center) team supports the operational health, performance, availability, interoperability, and reliability of Lowe’s technology systems. From the technology side, the team provides operational support across multiple areas, including Database platforms such as SQL, Oracle, DB2, and Sybase; Platform technologies including Windows, Unix and Linux; and Store technology, including store infrastructure and hardware.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The primary purpose of this role is to support operational health in performance, availability, interoperability, and reliability of technology systems by providing first\- and second\-level support for enterprise systems, Database and delivering infrastructure solutions in support of components of larger project\-based solutions. The role assists more senior level engineers with infrastructure planning, engineering, and architecture, works with business units to ensure solutions meet or exceed business requirements, and may deliver work on a smaller component scale independently. The Technology Operations Engineer will suggest, promote, and use published standards to minimize environment complexity and ensure regulatory and license compliance.
   

  

 This role requires providing 24x7 operational support and working the hours and schedule necessary to meet enterprise and business needs. Associates will work on a rotational shift schedule with rotational weekly offs and may be required to be on\-call or work alternate schedules based on operational and departmental requirements.

description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 Are you a seasoned professional with strong hands\-on expertise in virtualization, SDN, and network security, complemented by excellent consulting and communication skills? If so, you’ll thrive in our collaborative environment where you’ll lead the design and implementation of cutting\-edge data center and hybrid cloud solutions, make a significant impact on our clients' success, and advance your career as part of a dynamic team at Nutanix.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Staff Consulting Architect will be a vital member of Nutanix's Professional Services team, which is dedicated to delivering innovative virtualization, software\-defined networking (SDN), and network security solutions to our clients. This team operates from Bangalore or Pune and fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture that values creativity and knowledge sharing. The mission of the team is to empower organizations with next\-generation data center and hybrid cloud environments that enhance performance, security, and scalability.
   

  

 You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who promotes a supportive and mentoring leadership style, focusing on empowering team members to achieve their full potential and encouraging a strong sense of collaboration. The role is hybrid, requiring the employee to come into the office three days a week, fostering teamwork and facilitating knowledge exchange while allowing flexibility for remote work.
   

  

 Nutanix is seeking a
 **Staff Consulting Architect** 
 specializing in
 **virtualization, software\-defined networking (SDN), and network security** 
 to design, implement, and optimize next\-generation data centre and hybrid cloud environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess
 **strong hands\-on expertise in hypervisors (VMware / AHV)** 
 and a
 **deep understanding of network virtualization and microsegmentation concepts.**
 While certain specialized or automation\-related areas can be developed through internal enablement programs, strong fundamentals in virtualization and SDN are mandatory.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Architecture \& Design
* Lead the design and deployment of SDN solutions including:
+ Virtual networks, overlays (Geneve / VXLAN), logical switches and routers.
+ Network Controllers / Managers for centralized control and automation.
+ VPCs or logical segments for tenant isolation and scalability.
+ Gateways, VPNs, and BGP configurations for hybrid connectivity.

* Architect multi\-tier microsegmentation strategies and enforce Zero Trust principles.
* Collaborate with enterprise network and security teams for seamless integration between virtual and physical infrastructures.
* Implementation \& Delivery
* Configure SDN controllers, edge gateways, and security policies in production environments.
* Enable L2 extensions, VPN tunnels, and BGP sessions across sites or clouds.
* Implement application\-centric security and isolation policies for East\-West and North\-South traffic control.
* Support workload and network migrations between virtualization platforms with minimal downtime.
* Integrate network visibility and flow analytics into compliance systems.
* Security \& Policy Management
* Define and enforce microsegmentation and application security frameworks.
* Manage security groups, categories, or tags for dynamic policy application.
* Configure allowlist / denylist rules and quarantine mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards; integrate with SIEM / Syslog for auditability.
* Platform \& Virtualization Management
* Manage and optimize virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere / Nutanix AHV / equivalent).
* Administer orchestration and lifecycle management using Prism Central, vCenter, or similar tools.
* Support hybrid cloud network architectures spanning on\-premises and public cloud environments.
* Collaborate with compute and storage teams to ensure end\-to\-end performance.
* Troubleshooting \& Optimization
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to network overlays, routing, and policy enforcement.
* Utilize CLI tools, REST APIs, or automation scripts for diagnostics and configuration management.
* Perform performance tuning and maintain high availability of network services.


**What You Will Bring**
**Mandatory Skills (Must\-Have)**
* 10\+ years of experience in data centre virtualization and SDN solutions.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts — VLANs, routing, NAT, VPNs, BGP, firewalls, overlays (VXLAN/Geneve).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one SDN platform:
+ VMware NSX / Nutanix Flow / Cisco ACI (or equivalent).

* Proven expertise in microsegmentation and Zero Trust architecture design.
* Working knowledge of any one hypervisor (VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV, or Hyper\-V).
* Experience integrating virtual and physical network infrastructures.
* Strong troubleshooting skills using CLI / API / network analysis tools.
* Excellent consulting, customer engagement, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures.


**Trainable / Developable Skills**
*(These can be built on\-the\-job or via internal learning programs)*
* Automation and scripting using REST APIs, PowerShell, or Python.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform or Ansible.
* Exposure to hybrid or multi\-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Integration of flow analytics and visibility tools for monitoring and compliance.
* Performance tuning and advanced SDN optimization techniques.
* Mentoring, workshop facilitation, and leadership in technical communities.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong consulting and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills.
* Team mentorship and ability to guide junior consultants.
* Structured approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making.


**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline.
* Preferred Certifications (VCP\-NV, VCAP\-NV, CCNP Data Centre, Nutanix NCP).


**Location**
* Pune/Bangalore (Work from Office).
* Travel as required for customer assignments.

description:
**Department:** 
 Operations
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  




**Description**
 Are you a tech\-savvy problem solver with a passion for Linux and the future of AI? Brivo is looking for an Operations Engineer to bridge the gap between our cutting\-edge AI software and real\-world field deployments.
   

 You will keep our on\-field systems healthy, install them on customer sites, and act as the technical voice our customers hear — including when they ask hard questions about how we secure their data. This is more than a maintenance role: it is a launchpad into the worlds of DevOps, IoT, Deep Learning, and Cyber Security.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* **System Monitoring:** 
 Proactively monitor a growing fleet of on\-field Linux devices to ensure 100% uptime.
* **Technical Troubleshooting:** 
 Analyze application\-level bugs, resolve technical roadblocks, and maintain the health of installed systems.
* **Field Deployment:** 
 Lead the on\-site installation and configuration of our AI products, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with customer hardware.
* **Technical Support \& Consulting:** 
 Act as the technical point of contact for customers, resolving issues and identifying opportunities for system optimization.
* **Security Questionnaires:** 
 Respond to incoming cyber security questionnaires from current and new customers, uploading them using internal tools and preparing accurate, well\-evidenced responses.
* **Review \& Escalation:** 
 Review responses for completeness and escalate open items to subject matter experts as needed.
* **Documentation \& NDAs:** 
 Coordinate with Sales Engineering, Information Security, and other relevant teams to complete final packaging, send the required documents, and execute NDAs.
* **Knowledge Management:** 
 Own and maintain the internal tools, answer libraries, and documentation used for cyber security responses.
* **Sales Engineering:** 
 Assist in preparing technical proposals, security documentation, and the architecture for new client solutions.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with Sales, Product Managers, Engineering, and Information Security to define technical guidelines and product specifications based on customer feedback.
* **AI\-Assisted Productivity:** 
 Apply prompt engineering techniques with internal AI tools to draft, summarize, and improve technical and security documentation.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
* **OS Mastery:** 
 Solid knowledge of the Linux Operating System is mandatory.
* **Scripting:** 
 Basic proficiency in Python and Shell Scripting for automation.
* **Infrastructure:** 
 Strong grasp of Hardware and Networking fundamentals.
* **Cyber Security:** 
 1\+ year of relevant experience; a cyber security or related technical background is preferred.
* **Prompt Engineering:** 
 Working knowledge of prompt engineering and the practical use of AI/LLM tools for documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Ability to work with multiple stakeholders across teams to produce a single, consistent response.
* **Organization:** 
 Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to track parallel requests and deadlines.
* **Learning Agility:** 
 Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and systems.
* **Communication:** 
 Excellent verbal and written English skills (essential for customer interaction and documentation).
* **Certification:** 
 Red Hat Certification (RHCSA/RHCE), Cyber Security Certification is highly preferred.
* **Education:** 
 B.E. / B.Tech / BCA.
* **Languages:** 
 English, Hindi, and a local language.


**Who You Are:** 
* **Adaptable:** 
 You are comfortable toggling between remote system monitoring, hands\-on field installation, and desk\-based customer documentation.
* **Curious:** 
 You have a genuine interest in how IoT devices communicate and how AI models are deployed at the "edge."
* **Customer\-Centric:** 
 You can translate complex technical jargon into clear solutions for clients and stakeholders.
* **Security\-Minded:** 
 You understand why customers ask hard questions about security, and you treat every response as a reflection of our credibility.


**Benefits**
* **System\-level Linux troubleshooting:** 
 Networking fundamentals and the health of a distributed device fleet.
* **DevOps \& Microservices:** 
 Docker, RESTful APIs, and modern deployment pipelines.
* **AI Implementation:** 
 Real\-world application of Deep Learning and Intelligent Surveillance (NVR/DVR/IP Cameras).
* **Cyber Security \& Compliance:** 
 Customer security questionnaires, security documentation, and NDA workflows.
* **Applied AI \& Prompt Engineering:** 
 Using AI and LLM tooling effectively to research, draft, and refine technical content.


**About Brivo**
 Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises.
   

  

 As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. description:
**Description**
 Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
   

  

 Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live events \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add\-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast\-paced, growth business \- available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
   

  

 The Live Operations Event Support team is seeking Support Engineers to own the operation and end\-to\-end monitoring of linear TV and live streaming events on Prime Video. This role requires strong troubleshooting and networking expertise, with a passion to learn and grow in the OTT live streaming domain. You will work with internal and external partners to ensure video signals from partners are received from various venues, routed through our encoding/packaging infrastructure, and successfully delivered to customer devices. We use tools and consumer devices in fully\-equipped operations centers to monitor every stage of the signal path.
   

  

 Every Support Engineer on this team, is expected to bring an AI\-first mindset—leveraging automation to build intelligent workflows leading to best customer/support engineer experience. You will closely collaborate with engineering teams, serve as the voice of the customer within the live operations organization, and drive efficiency initiatives that measurably improve operational outcomes.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Execute multiple live streaming events concurrently, ensuring our customers have the highest quality experience
   

  

 Make in\-room decisions, organising tasks between service partners, and directing other support engineers working on live events.
   

  

 Work with peers and other teams on high\-severity, active support issues, prioritising mitigation while investigating root\-cause fixes
   

  

 Deliver reports to senior leadership
   

  

 Provide on\-call support and act as point of escalation for high\-severity issues
   

  

 Aid in the development and testing of operational tools that improve efficiency through automation
   

  

 Ownership of one or more systems or tools
   

  

 Customer notification and workflow co\-ordination with follow\-up to maintain service level agreements
   

  

 Creating and maintaining team specific knowledge\-base articles and operational and training documentation
   

  

 Assist in the training of new support staff as the team grows
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Live Operations team monitors playback continuously across linear channels and live streaming events using AI\-driven automation alongside traditional broadcast monitoring techniques. Should an issue arise, Amazon has a highly skilled global team of engineers and developers whom our support engineers collaborate with to quickly mitigate and resolve issues, preventing disruption to customers.
   

  

 Support engineers leverage an AI\-first approach to suppress, correlate, and reduce noise—identifying actionable signals from vast data points and communicating these out to stakeholders with speed and precision. You will drive efficiency initiatives by building and refining automations that reduce manual toil and improve response times. Due to the nature of linear TV and live events, the team provides 24\*7 coverage and engineers work across rotational shifts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our role is to monitor and mitigate on behalf of the customer 24x7 across linear TV and live streaming events.
   

  

 Our primary goal is to deliver a stellar streaming experience across thousands of linear channels and live events to Prime Video customers worldwide, collaborating with content providers and engineering teams to uphold the highest standards. We serve as the voice of the customer within the support engineering organization—championing reliability, driving automation, and continuously raising the bar.
   

  

 We maintain thousands of hours of content per day, measuring success by the number of hours delivered without issues and the efficiency gains achieved through intelligent automation.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of technical support experience
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience troubleshooting and documenting findings
* Experience with video encoding and streaming media standards
* Knowledge of system, network and OS


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience driving collaborative projects from conception to delivery
* Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large\-scale optimizations
* Experience leveraging GenAI to develop solutions that can reduce time to triage or time to resolve technical support issues

title: Wireless Network Engineer
description:
**Wi\-Fi \& RF design expert** 




  
 



 About the Company
 



  
 



 We are a leading internet service provider in India that was founded in 2007\. The company’s primary goal is to provide affordable and reliable internet connectivity to customers across India. We started by setting up a Campus Wi\-Fi network at Manipal University, Manipal, and later expanded its Wi\-Fi services to hospitality, co\-living, airports, malls, and other public spaces. The company owned and operated the largest campus Wi\-Fi network in the country and the Wi\-Fi network in some of the leading Indian hospitality chains, including Taj, Lalit, Lemon Tree, and Ginger.
 



  
 



 In 2011, we forayed into the residential broadband segment and became one of the first companies to adopt the highly reliable and high\-speed GPoN technology for delivering broadband services to its residential customers. We deliver speeds of up to 1 Gbps to its residential customers, and its unlimited data plans have been particularly popular among users who require highly reliable high\-speed bandwidth applications such as streaming video and online gaming. Currently, our services are available, both directly and indirectly through franchisees, in more than 3 lakhs residences across the country.
 



  





 Full\-time · permanent \| Engineering \& Product \| Bengaluru (WFO) \- 5 days a week
 



 Reports to: Head of Engineering \| Experience: 6–10 years 
 



  
 



 About the Role 
 



 Own end\-to\-end Wi\-Fi and RF design — from product specification and hardware selection through field deployment standards, NOC integration, and ongoing performance optimisation across a growing fleet targeting 100,000\+ APs. 
 



 You will be the technical authority on all 802\.11 matters — defining AP placement methodology, SSID/VLAN architecture, roaming behaviour, VoWiFi quality, RF interference management, and the Wi\-Fi\-specific sections of the product programme document. 
 



 This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant product influence. You will work across engineering, NOC, and product to translate RF design decisions into deployable configurations, monitoring thresholds, and automated remediation logic. 
 



  





 Key Responsibilities 
 



  





 RF \& Wireless Design 
 



 AP placement methodology — define AI\-assisted and manual survey\-based placement standards for villas, colliding \& coworking spaces. 
 



 RF interference management — identify and mitigate co\-channel and adjacent\-channel interference; define noise floor thresholds and corrective actions for NOC engineers. 
 



 Capacity planning — define client density limits per AP, MU\-MIMO/OFDMA utilisation targets, and load\-balancing triggers per deployment type. 
 



  





 Product and Configuration Design 
 



  





 SSID and VLAN architecture — own the Wi\-Fi specific sections of the PPD: 
 



 SSID design, VLAN mapping, WPA3 enforcement, 802\.11r/k/v roaming parameters, and sticky client remediation ladder. 
 



 VoWiFi quality design — define WMM/DSCP marking, U\-APSD config, roaming protection during active calls, IKE session stability requirements, and 
 



 SIP ALG mandates across CPE and ONT. 
 



 Hardware evaluation and selection — evaluate, test, and qualify AP hardware; define minimum spec requirements for future hardware additions; manage 
 



 BIS/WPC compliance verification. 
 



 Controller configuration standards — define controller configuration templates, 
 



 ZTP provisioning parameters, mobility domain IDs, and per\-site roaming boundaries. 
 



  





 NOC \& Monitoring Integration 
 



  





 Threshold definition — own all Wi\-Fi performance thresholds in the PPD: 
 



 RSSI targets, channel utilisation limits, roaming latency, MCS rate floors, sticky client event rates, and VoWiFi quality targets (jitter, MOS, IKE stability). 
 



 Alert and CFA design — define P1–P4 alert conditions for all Wi\-Fi metrics; write call\-for\-action playbooks for NOC engineers covering RF\-related faults including coverage gaps, interference, sticky clients, and VoWiFi degradation. 
 



 Wi\-Fi health score — own the health score formula (coverage, speed, uptime, 
 



 VoWiFi, roaming components); define weighting adjustments as fleet data matures. 
 



  
 



 Field \& Operational Standards 
 



  





 Installation SOPs — define RF\-specific installation standards for the remote first, app\-guided install model; cable routing, AP mounting height and orientation, backhaul port usage, and post\-install validation checklist. 
 



 Firmware governance — define the canary testing protocol for AP firmware updates; review release notes for RF\-impacting changes; own the 5%→fleet rollout schedule. 
 



 L2/L3 Wi\-Fi troubleshooting support — provide expert escalation support to the NOC for complex RF issues not resolvable via standard playbooks; 
 



 conduct remote RF analysis using controller data and Grafana metrics. 
 



 Skills and Experience Required: 
 



 802\.11 Protocols: Wi\-Fi 6 (802\.11ax), 802\.11r/k/v roaming, WPA3 / 802\.11W 
 



 PMF, OFDMA / MU\-MIMO \& Wi\-Fi 7 (802\.11be)   
 



 RF Design Tools: Ekahau / iBwave, Manual RF survey, Spectrum analysis, 
 



 AI placement tools, 3D floor plan modelling  
 



 Controllers and Platforms: Cambium cnMaestro/AirPro, Cisco Meraki / 
 



 Catalyst, Aruba Central, Ruckus SmartZone \& Ubiquiti UniFi      
 



 Networking Fundamentals: VLANs / 802\.1Q, WMM / DSCP / QoS, 
 



 IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, CAPWAP / controller arch \& WIDS/WIPS 
 



 VoWiFi \& Voice Quality: IKE / IPSec passthrough, SIP ALG impact analysis, 
 



 MOS / jitter / latency, U\-APSD / WMM AC\_VO \& IMS / ePDG architecture 
 



 Monitoring \& Analytics: Grafana dashboard design, Prometheus / SNMP metrics, RF log analysis, TimescaleDB queries \& PromQL basics      
 



 ISP / Access Network: GPON / EPON / ONT, TR\-069 / ACS basics, CPE dual\-WAN design \& TRAI QoS standards 
 



 Soft Skills: Technical documentation, Cross\-functional collaboration, NOC playbook writing, Vendor evaluation \& Field team training 
 



  





 Qualifications \- B.E./B. Tech in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related field \- CWNA (Certified Wireless Network Administrator) or equivalent \- CWDP / CWAP / CWSP \- Cambium Certified Wi\-Fi Professional or Cisco CCNP Wireless \- 6–10 years of hands\-on Wi\-Fi/RF design experience

description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Zelis is modernizing its infrastructure estate — migrating workloads to AWS and Azure, consolidating data centers, and re\-platforming the network for a cloud\-first, high\-availability future. We are hiring a Senior Network Engineer in Hyderabad to help lead this transformation from the ground up: designing and operating resilient network architectures across on\-premises data centers and hybrid cloud, executing complex migration and consolidation cutovers, and keeping a healthcare\-grade environment secure, observable, and always on.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on senior role for an engineer who can own technically demanding work end to end — architecture through troubleshooting — drive it independently to closure, and partner closely with stakeholders across both the US and India organizations in a matrixed, follow\-the\-sun operating model.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud modernization \& hybrid connectivity**
* Design and deliver hybrid and cloud network architectures across AWS and Azure — VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway/Virtual WAN, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, VPN, DNS, and segmentation — aligned to the cloud modernization roadmap.
* Build connectivity between on\-premises data centers and cloud landing zones, ensuring performance, redundancy, and secure east\-west and north\-south traffic flows.
* Codify the network as infrastructure — authoring and reviewing Terraform and Ansible so cloud and hybrid network changes are repeatable, versioned, and auditable.


**Data center consolidation \& migration**
* Plan and execute network cutovers for data center consolidation and workload migration — discovery, dependency mapping, low\-level design, migration runbooks, and rollback plans.
* Lead cutover events including out\-of\-hours change windows, coordinating validation and hyper\-care with application, cloud, and infrastructure teams across sites.
* Refactor and decommission legacy DC network components (routing, switching, firewall rules, load\-balancer configs, IP space) as sites are consolidated, retiring technical debt safely.


**Network engineering \& operations**
* Design, implement, and operate enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VXLAN/EVPN), data center fabric (Cisco Nexus/ACI or equivalent), SD\-WAN, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Own complex troubleshooting as an escalation point for high\-severity and cross\-domain network incidents — driving root\-cause analysis, resolution, and prevention with minimal supervision.
* Strengthen resilience and security through segmentation, zero\-trust principles, and hardening consistent with healthcare compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, PCI\-DSS) and Zelis standards.


**Observability, automation \& continuous improvement**
* Improve visibility using monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., SolarWinds, ThousandEyes, NetFlow, SNMP, Datadog) with actionable alerting and dashboards.
* Automate recurring work — configuration management, compliance checks, and remediation — using Python, Ansible, and CI/CD to reduce manual effort and change risk.
* Maintain standards — up\-to\-date designs, runbooks, and diagrams (HLD/LLD) — and contribute to network standards, patterns, and best practices.


**Collaboration \& stakeholder engagement**
* Partner across US and India stakeholders — cloud, DevOps, SRE, IT operations, security, and application teams — in a matrixed, follow\-the\-sun model, ensuring smooth handoffs and shared context.
* Drive work independently translating ambiguous requirements into clear plans, sequencing tasks, and delivering to timelines without close oversight.
* Communicate clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders — status, risk, and impact — and mentor junior engineers on the team.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on enterprise network engineering experience, including a senior/lead role on medium\-to\-large environments.
* Deep, demonstrable expertise in routing and switching — BGP, OSPF, VLANs, spanning tree, and multicast — with strong fundamentals in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and NAT.
* Proven data center networking experience (Cisco Nexus/ACI, Arista, or equivalent) and hands\-on hybrid cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure (VPC/VNet, Transit Gateway/vWAN, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, VPN, security groups/NSGs).
* Hands\-on experience with firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco Firepower/ASA, or Fortinet), load balancers (F5 or equivalent), and SD\-WAN.
* Direct experience delivering data center migration and/or consolidation projects, including cutover planning and execution during change windows.
* Practical network automation skills — Python and/or Ansible — and working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) and Git\-based workflows.
* Strong, independent troubleshooting ability across the network stack, with a structured root\-cause approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of collaborating across geographically distributed (US/India) teams and time zones.
* Design hybrid\-cloud networking solutions connecting AWS, on\-premises data centers, and third\-party providers.
* Leverage Megaport and similar cloud interconnection platforms to provide scalable and resilient connectivity.
* Drive network automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, APIs, and Git.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, and cloud networking certifications (AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate).
* Experience with VXLAN/EVPN fabrics, zero\-trust / micro segmentation, and DNS/IPAM platforms (e.g., Infoblox).
* Familiarity with observability at scale (Logic Monitor, New Relic, Datadog) and ITSM/change\-management practices (Jira Service Management).
* Exposure to regulated environments (healthcare, payments, or financial services) and associated compliance controls.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to standards, design reviews, or communities of practice.

 Hitachi Energy is the world leader in Power Quality Solutions (PQS). Hitachi Energy was the first to introduce Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) technology to the power industry and has delivered solutions for more than 50 years now. Hitachi energy has several solutions that enhance the security, capacity, and flexibility of power transmission systems. These solutions enable power grid owners to increase existing transmission network capacity while maintaining or improving the operating margins necessary for grid stability.  Hitachi Energy has the full FACTS portfolio and in\-house manufacturing of key components. Our PQS R\&D group in Chennai is focusing on developing and evaluating functionalities for STATCOM, STATIC VAR Compensator (SVC), Series Compensator and Synchronous Condensers for utilities and industries. Hitachi Energy uses a very high\-end system for its control, protection and monitoring of FACTS solution called MACH (Modular Advanced Control for HVDC and FACTS). This is a system of computers built with state\-of\-the\-art electronics, microprocessors and digital signal processors.

* To research and develop the control philosophy for new and evolving technologies / to improve the control performance of any existing technologies in power quality domain.
* To implement, verify \& validate the developed control and protection logic in MACH control system thereby creating a rigorously tested, stable baseline solution which later can be tailored to meet specific customers’ requirements.
* To perform simulation of control logics and verification on control logics in software in loop environment (with the help of tools including but not limited to MATLAB scripts, MATLAB Simulink and PSCAD)
* To perform validation testing of the whole FACTS system in a hardware in loop environment with real time digital simulator setup. (ex: RTDS interfaced with MACH system)
* Traveling sites to support various R\&D activities or troubleshooting ongoing FACTS projects.
* To be responsible for the deliverables assigned in terms of quality, on time delivery and proactive communication of progress to the R\&D project management, work\-stream lead and other stakeholders.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living with Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

* Must have strong understanding of various power system concepts including knowledge of performing power system studies like load flow, short circuit, transient stability and switching transients for utility / industrial systems.

description:

**Job Summary**

This role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business\-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this senior role you will lead, direct, and advise cross\-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory\-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.
   

  

 Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.
   

  

**Core Focus Areas**
 The Principal Architect is expected to be generally familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. The ideal candidate for this role will have deep technical knowledge of and hands\-on experience with Network Security (including SASE) and AI Security.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:**
* Establish and maintain executive\-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.
* Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.
* Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.
* Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.
* Conduct high\-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.


**Sales Productivity And Thought Leadership**
* Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.
* Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.


**Internal Partnership And Development**
* Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.
* Maintain continuous self\-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)
* Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.


**Qualifications**
**Requirements and Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.
* Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.
* Architectural Knowledge:
+ Must have deep knowledge of network security and SASE/Zero Trust. Preferred experience in security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, incident response, cloud security, identity management, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI is a plus.
+ Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.
+ Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

* Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).
* Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.
* Drive and Problem Solving:
+ A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.
+ Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

* Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%\+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.
* Organisational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
