title: IT Manager
description:
IT Manager \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Own the systems a real assets platform runs on — the accounting and business applications, the devices, the network, the security — and implement the ones it does not have yet. One IT manager commanding vendors, not running a department.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Chief Financial Officer · until that seat is filled, the General Manager — Finance \& Accounts · EXPERIENCE: 8–12 years in IT and business\-systems management, including at least one ERP or accounting\-system implementation you ran
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 THE OPERATING LAYER HAS AN OWNER
 



 Vantrock runs on its dashboards. Models, trackers, the close calendar, the Asset Review pack, the matter tracker — all of it lives on the platform's operating layer, and the platform's own intelligence arm builds the tools that sit on top. But somebody has to own the layer underneath: the accounting and business applications and their implementation; the devices every person works on; the network in the office and at every site; the identities, access and security that keep a finance function's data where it belongs; the licences, the vendors and the budget.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 A finance function of twenty\-one seats keeping its books in\-house needs an accounting system implemented properly, integrated with the platform's dashboards, secured, backed up and supported — before the first month\-end runs on it. A platform with sites to open in four cities needs each one connected and equipped on the day it does. And a company built to run on technology needs someone whose job is that the technology runs. None of that exists yet as a function. This seat is it.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. The accounting and business systems. The finance function's system of record — selected with the Chief Financial Officer and the General Manager, implemented on a plan you run, integrated with the platform's operating layer, and supported after go\-live.
 



 2\. Implementations. Every system the platform adopts taken from decision to daily use: requirements with the function head, vendor selection, configuration, data migration, testing, training, cut\-over, hyper\-care.
 



 3\. Devices, network and sites. Every person equipped and connected; the office and every project site on a network that works; new sites live on the day they open.
 



 4\. Identity, access and security. Who can see what, enforced in the systems, not in a policy document.
 



 5\. Vendors and licences. The IT vendors, the software licences, the support contracts — scoped, negotiated, held to their service levels, and inside the budget you own.
 



 6\. Support. The first call when something does not work, and a standard for how fast it is fixed — with the platform's intelligence arm as your partner for anything that touches the product layer.
 



 7\. The technology roadmap. A written, budgeted view of what the platform will need in twelve and twenty\-four months, refreshed each quarter with the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  
 



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 ESSENTIAL
 



 – 8–12 years in IT management and business systems, of which a meaningful part at a mid\-sized company where you were the IT function, not a member of one.
 



 – At least one ERP or accounting\-system implementation run end to end by you — requirements to hyper\-care — for a finance team that then used it. This will be discussed in detail.
 



 – Devices, networks, identity and access, and information security managed for a distributed business — more than one office or site.
 



 – Vendor and licence management as the client: scoping, negotiating, service levels, budget.
 



 – Comfortable with a finance function's requirements — you can talk to a controller about a chart of accounts and to a payables head about approval workflows.
 



 – Hands\-on when needed, and honest about what you do not know.
 



 – Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 



 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – Not a software\-development seat. The platform's product and AI tools are built by its intelligence arm; this seat runs the layer they sit on.
 



 – Not a helpdesk seat. Support is part of the job; the implementations and the security are the job.
 



 – Not a large\-team management seat. You command vendors; you do not manage a department.
 



  
 



 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



 – Outsource the doing, own the outcome. Vendors implement and support; you command them and are accountable for the result.
 



 – Everything runs on the platform's dashboards. The asset register, the licence log, the ticket queue and the roadmap live on the operating layer.
 



 – Judgment is written down. Every implementation has a plan and a sign\-off; every access change has a record; every incident has a cause.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, with travel to sites.
 



  
 



 COMPENSATION
 



 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 



 Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus, and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives as the seat grows — priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.
 



  
 



 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat. You work fluently with AI tools for research, modelling, drafting and analysis, and you build on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test is part of the process for every seat, at every level of seniority, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second standing requirement. The books are ours, but auditors, banks, the fund administrator, valuers, law firms and system vendors are commanded by this team — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to. We hire for judgment and accountability.
 



  
 



 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days. It carries two links: a fixed set of six questions answered by AI interview — about forty minutes, and the first work sample; we review it before the CV — and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there:
 



 1\. The Implementation conversation. The ERP or accounting system you implemented: the plan, what went wrong at cut\-over, what the finance team said six months later. With the General Manager — Finance \& Accounts, or the Chief Financial Officer once in seat.
 



 2\. A 90\-minute supervised case. A brief for a finance function of twenty seats going live on a new accounting system in ninety days, across a head office and two sites — from which you produce the implementation plan, the access model and the three risks that would derail it. Reviewed with the General Manager and the Founder \& CEO.
 



 3\. References. Two, contacted directly: one former reporting manager and one finance\-function user of a system you implemented.
 



 Once we have received your application, your AI interview and your test, we will reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  
 



 TO APPLY
 



 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "IT Manager — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. This is mandatory — a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application; we will read your LinkedIn as well.
 



 – Your Systems Sheet — one row per system you implemented or ran: system, function served, users, your role, year, outcome. The template is available on request.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to see to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the mistake most companies make in the first thirty days of an accounting\-system implementation, and how you would stop this one making it. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read everything that arrives with a Systems Sheet and a paragraph — properly, not skimmed. If this sounds like your seat, write to us.
 



  
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 




 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock

title: Senior Network Engineer – Cloud Platform
description:
****Position:****
 Senior Network Engineer – Cloud Platform
   

  

****Job Description:****
* Role Overview Join the Cloud Platform Engineering team responsible for designing, building, automating, securing, and operating enterprise cloud, corporate, server, and data center infrastructure. This role requires deep expertise in enterprise networking, cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, infrastructure automation, network security, observability, and production operations across AWS, GCP, OCI, corporate offices, remote sites, and data centers. Shift Timing 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST


**Key Responsibilities:**
 Cloud Network Engineering

* Establish standardized cloud networking patterns and reusable network architecture frameworks.
* Support multi\-account, multi\-region, and multi\-cloud deployments across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Design highly available, resilient, scalable, and secure network architectures.
* Support cloud landing zones and cloud foundation initiatives.


 Enterprise \& Corporate Networking
   

  

* Design, implement, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure.
* Manage and troubleshoot VLANs, Routing, Switching, Wireless Networks, VPNs, Firewalls, Proxies, and Network Access Controls.
* Establish secure connectivity between corporate offices, remote locations, data centers, and cloud environments.
* Monitor network availability, utilization, capacity, and performance trends.
* Drive lifecycle management, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects.


 Server Infrastructure Management
   

  

* Design and manage connectivity supporting Linux, Windows, physical, virtual, and cloud\-hosted servers.
* Troubleshoot DNS, routing, firewall, certificate, server communication, storage, and application connectivity issues.
* Support provisioning, decommissioning, migration, and modernization efforts.
* Ensure secure segmentation between applications, servers, storage, and cloud environments.


 Hybrid \& Multi\-Cloud Connectivity
   

  

* Manage AWS Direct Connect, AWS Site\-to\-Site VPN, AWS Transit Gateway, GCP Cloud Interconnect, GCP Cloud VPN, OCI FastConnect, and OCI VPN.
* Design and manage secure connectivity across on\-premises, cloud, remote, and data center environments.
* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end connectivity issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud ecosystems.
* Design resilient architectures eliminating single points of failure.


 Network Architecture \& Design
   

  

* Develop architecture diagrams, design documentation, reference architectures, and operational standards.
* Design scalable IP address management, subnetting, routing, and DNS strategies.
* Establish standards for traffic flow, network segmentation, connectivity, and security.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic improvements.


 Network Security
   

  

* Design and manage Security Groups, Network ACLs, Cloud Firewalls, WAFs, Firewall Policies, Network Segmentation, and Private Endpoints.
* Support TLS/SSL, Certificates, Encryption, Secure Communication, and Zero Trust initiatives.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network activities and security events.
* Partner with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and strengthen compliance posture.


 Infrastructure as Code \& Automation
   

  

* Develop and maintain network infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration validation, compliance checks, testing, and operational processes.
* Develop automation using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Support CI/CD\-driven infrastructure deployment and change management.


 Network Monitoring \& Observability
   

  

* Monitor latency, throughput, packet loss, DNS performance, load balancer health, VPN health, connectivity, and utilization.
* Leverage Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, telemetry, and observability platforms.
* Create operational dashboards, alerts, and proactive monitoring frameworks.
* Analyze telemetry and logs to improve reliability and performance.


 Production Support \& Incident Management
   

  

* Provide L3 support for critical network, server, cloud, and connectivity incidents.
* Troubleshoot routing failures, DNS outages, VPN issues, firewall problems, application connectivity issues, and cloud networking incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Participate in on\-call support, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity activities.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience including cloud networking.
* Strong AWS networking expertise with exposure to GCP and OCI.
* Hands\-on experience with LAN/WAN, hybrid cloud, server, and data center infrastructure.
* Strong Terraform, Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation capabilities.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.


 Strong Understanding Of
   

  

* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, BGP, OSPF, VPN, NAT.
* Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancing, TLS/SSL, and Network Segmentation.
* Cloud Networking Services and Enterprise Connectivity.
* Hybrid Cloud Architecture and Network Security Principles.


 Technical Skills Matrix
   

  

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP, OCI
* Networking: VPC, VCN, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, FastConnect, DNS, Routing, Switching, VPN
* Security: Palo Alto, Cisco, F5, WAF, ACLs, Security Groups, TLS/SSL
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell
* Monitoring: Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, Telemetry
* Operating Systems: Linux, Windows Server


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS, OCI, GCP, Cisco, or Palo Alto certifications.
* Experience working in large\-scale enterprise and multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation programs.
* Experience collaborating with SRE, Systems Engineering, Security, and Cloud Engineering teams.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Highly reliable and secure network connectivity across all environments.
* Reduced operational effort through automation and infrastructure standardization.
* Improved network observability, stability, performance, and security.
* Reusable network architecture patterns and Terraform modules adopted across teams.
* Recognized technical leadership and mentorship within engineering organizations.


 Why Join The Team
   

  

* Work on a modern cloud platform supporting global products and services.
* Drive strategic infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives.
* Influence enterprise networking standards, governance, and architecture.
* Work alongside Cloud, Security, SRE, Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering experts.

description:
About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and service\-oriented **IT Technician** to provide technical support, installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and configuration of IT hardware, networking equipment, systems, and end\-user devices.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of the company's IT infrastructure and providing timely technical support to employees and project sites.

Key Responsibilities1\. IT Hardware \& Desktop Support

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical support to employees.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues.
* Install and configure Windows operating systems and required applications.
* Perform system upgrades, hardware replacements, and preventive maintenance.
* Maintain IT asset records and equipment inventory.

2\. Networking Support

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot basic LAN/WAN infrastructure.
* Support switches, routers, Wi\-Fi access points, and network devices.
* Troubleshoot LAN connectivity, internet, IP, DNS, and DHCP\-related issues.
* Assist in network cable installation, termination, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Identify and resolve network connectivity problems at office and project sites.
* Maintain basic network documentation.

3\. IT Infrastructure Support

* Support servers, network equipment, UPS systems, and other IT infrastructure.
* Monitor basic IT infrastructure and report abnormalities.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and external IT vendors when required.
* Assist with backup and system maintenance activities.
* Ensure proper functioning of office IT systems.

* Diagnose and resolve technical problems within defined timelines.
* Maintain records of reported issues and resolutions.
* Escalate complex technical problems to senior IT personnel or vendors.
* Provide guidance to users on basic IT\-related issues.

* Install and configure authorized software and applications.
* Manage antivirus and endpoint security installations.
* Perform Windows updates and security patches.
* Ensure systems comply with company IT policies.

* Troubleshoot scanners, biometric devices, projectors, displays, and other peripherals.

* Maintain asset allocation and return records.
* Track equipment repairs, replacements, and warranties.
* Support periodic IT asset audits.

* Desktop and laptop hardware troubleshooting.
* Basic LAN/WAN knowledge.
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP fundamentals.
* Switch and router basics.

* Network cable termination and testing.
* Printer and peripheral troubleshooting.
* Microsoft Office 365 / MS Office support.
* Antivirus and endpoint security basics.
* Basic IT asset management.
* Basic AV and video conferencing troubleshooting.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of the following will be an added advantage:

* Cisco / Aruba / TP\-Link / D\-Link networking equipment.
* Microsoft 365 administration.
* Active Directory basics.
* CCTV and access\-control systems.
* Structured cabling.
* Fiber optic basics.

title: Senior Network Engineer – Cloud Platform

* Design, implement, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure.
* Manage and troubleshoot VLANs, Routing, Switching, Wireless Networks, VPNs, Firewalls, Proxies, and Network Access Controls.

* Monitor network availability, utilization, capacity, and performance trends.
* Drive lifecycle management, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects.

* Support provisioning, decommissioning, migration, and modernization efforts.
* Ensure secure segmentation between applications, servers, storage, and cloud environments.

* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end connectivity issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud ecosystems.
* Design resilient architectures eliminating single points of failure.


 Network Architecture \& Design
   

  

* Develop architecture diagrams, design documentation, reference architectures, and operational standards.
* Design scalable IP address management, subnetting, routing, and DNS strategies.
* Establish standards for traffic flow, network segmentation, connectivity, and security.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic improvements.


 Network Security
   

  

* Design and manage Security Groups, Network ACLs, Cloud Firewalls, WAFs, Firewall Policies, Network Segmentation, and Private Endpoints.
* Support TLS/SSL, Certificates, Encryption, Secure Communication, and Zero Trust initiatives.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network activities and security events.
* Partner with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and strengthen compliance posture.


 Infrastructure as Code \& Automation
   

  

* Develop and maintain network infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration validation, compliance checks, testing, and operational processes.
* Develop automation using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Support CI/CD\-driven infrastructure deployment and change management.


 Network Monitoring \& Observability
   

  

* Monitor latency, throughput, packet loss, DNS performance, load balancer health, VPN health, connectivity, and utilization.
* Leverage Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, telemetry, and observability platforms.
* Create operational dashboards, alerts, and proactive monitoring frameworks.
* Analyze telemetry and logs to improve reliability and performance.


 Production Support \& Incident Management
   

  

* Provide L3 support for critical network, server, cloud, and connectivity incidents.
* Troubleshoot routing failures, DNS outages, VPN issues, firewall problems, application connectivity issues, and cloud networking incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Participate in on\-call support, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity activities.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience including cloud networking.
* Strong AWS networking expertise with exposure to GCP and OCI.
* Hands\-on experience with LAN/WAN, hybrid cloud, server, and data center infrastructure.
* Strong Terraform, Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation capabilities.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.


 Strong Understanding Of
   

  

* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, BGP, OSPF, VPN, NAT.
* Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancing, TLS/SSL, and Network Segmentation.
* Cloud Networking Services and Enterprise Connectivity.
* Hybrid Cloud Architecture and Network Security Principles.

* Networking: VPC, VCN, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, FastConnect, DNS, Routing, Switching, VPN
* Security: Palo Alto, Cisco, F5, WAF, ACLs, Security Groups, TLS/SSL
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell
* Monitoring: Datadog, CloudWatch, Flow Logs, Telemetry
* Operating Systems: Linux, Windows Server


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS, OCI, GCP, Cisco, or Palo Alto certifications.
* Experience working in large\-scale enterprise and multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation programs.
* Experience collaborating with SRE, Systems Engineering, Security, and Cloud Engineering teams.

* Highly reliable and secure network connectivity across all environments.

* Improved network observability, stability, performance, and security.
* Reusable network architecture patterns and Terraform modules adopted across teams.
* Recognized technical leadership and mentorship within engineering organizations.

* Work alongside Cloud, Security, SRE, Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering experts.

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
**Who are we \-** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for an IT Network Engineer who can help us move even faster.
 



  





 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated and hands\-on
 **IT Network Engineer** 
 with minimum
 **4 years of experience** 
 to manage and support the IT infrastructure at our
 **Gurugram Corporate Office** 
 while also providing operational support to corporate offices across the
 **UAE, KSA, and Egypt** 
 remotely.Occasional international travel to these regional offices may be required to support new office setups, network and voice infrastructure deployments, major hardware installations, equipment replacements, migrations, or other activities that require onsite technical presence and hands\-on configuration.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong experience in designing, configuring, administering, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, wireless networks, VPNs, and network security solutions. In addition, the candidate should have practical experience configuring, managing, and troubleshooting
 **Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Cisco Voice Gateways, SIP trunks, SIP\-based telephony,** 
 and related voice infrastructure to ensure reliable and high\-quality enterprise communication services.
 



 The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining highly available and secure network and voice infrastructure, ensuring business continuity of critical IT services, resolving complex network and voice\-related incidents, supporting end\-user infrastructure, and collaborating with regional IT teams, telecom service providers, and vendors on operational and project initiatives. The role requires excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills, a strong customer service orientation, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced multinational environment while supporting multiple geographically distributed offices.
 



**Technical Expertise:** 



* Configure, administer, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco enterprise network infrastructure, including
* Cisco routers, Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, wireless controllers, wireless access points, firewalls, and Cisco Voice Gateways.
* Configure and administer Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Cisco Unified Border Element (CUBE), Cisco Voice Gateways, SIP trunks, MGCP, H.323, SIP, UCCX, CUP and UCS.
* Design, configure, maintain, and support enterprise IP Telephony (VoIP) and PBX solutions.
* Manage SIP trunks, Direct Inward Dialing (DID) numbers, phone extensions, dial plans, and voice routing.
* Implement and optimize Quality of Service (QoS) policies to ensure high\-quality voice communications.
* Perform Cisco Smart Licensing administration, SmartNet contract management, software lifecycle management, and license renewals.
* Support Windows Server and Linux server administration, including installation, configuration, patching, failover clustering, and basic troubleshooting.
* Participate in infrastructure lifecycle management, including firmware upgrades, hardware refreshes, and technology migrations.



**Network Security Infrastructure:** 



* Configure and troubleshoot enterprise routing, switching, VPNs, and Cisco SD\-WAN environments.
* Maintain network security infrastructure, including firewalls, VPN solutions, Network Access Control (NAC), and secure remote access.
* Plan, manage, and maintain IP address allocation using IP Address Management (IPAM) tools.
* Support enterprise wireless networking technologies and troubleshoot wireless performance issues.
* Ensure compliance with corporate IT security standards and cybersecurity best practices.
* Conduct periodic network vulnerability assessments and security reviews.



**Cloud Technologies:** 



* Support hybrid cloud connectivity within Microsoft Azure environments.
* Configure and troubleshoot Local Network Gateways, Azure Virtual WAN (vWAN), VPN, Gateways, and hybrid network connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud and application teams to secure hybrid cloud infrastructure and optimize network performance.
* Be familiar with cloud technologies such as Cisco Meraki Cloud.



**Monitoring and Automation:** 



* Monitor enterprise infrastructure using tools such as SolarWinds, Zabbix, PRTG, or equivalent monitoring platforms.
* Configure alerts, dashboards, reporting, and proactive monitoring.
* Automate routine network administration tasks using scripting or automation tools where applicable.
* Support capacity planning and performance optimization initiatives.



**Network Support and Optimization:** 



* Provide Level 3 (L3\) network and voice support for enterprise infrastructure.
* Diagnose and resolve complex routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, and VoIP issues.
* Plan and execute network implementations, upgrades, migrations, and office expansion projects.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) and telecom providers for Dedicated Internet
* Access (DIA), MPLS, leased circuits, and SIP trunk services.
* Review infrastructure utilization and recommend improvements to ensure optimal performance, scalability, and resilience.
* Participate in after\-hours maintenance activities and critical incident response when required.



**Documentation and Problem Resolution:** 



* Maintain accurate network diagrams, topology maps, IP addressing documentation, configuration backups, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and asset inventories.
* Maintain incident records, change documentation, and service reports.
* Produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports and operational playbooks for recurring incidents.
* Build operational dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Ensure compliance with company IT policies and applicable local and international cybersecurity standards.



**Process Improvement and Planning:** 



* Identify opportunities to improve network reliability, automation, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
* Develop implementation plans for new technologies, infrastructure upgrades, and equipment deployments.
* Recommend best practices to improve service availability, security, and operational excellence.



**Troubleshooting and Support:** 



* Diagnose and resolve enterprise network, security, cloud connectivity, and IP telephony issues.
* Provide technical support to end users for connectivity, collaboration, and telephony services.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation and be available to provide remote or onsite support for critical business incidents outside normal working hours when required.



**Experience:** 



* 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience in enterprise IT Network Infrastructure within a Cisco environment.
* Minimum 2 years of experience supporting Windows Server and Linux server environments.
* Experience supporting Cisco Collaboration and Voice technologies in an enterprise environment is highly preferred.
* Experience supporting multinational or geographically distributed offices is an advantage.



  





**Qualifications:** 




**Must haves:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).



**Good to have:** 



* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Enterprise).
* Cisco Collaboration certifications (CCNP Collaboration or equivalent) are highly desirable.
* Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\) or equivalent cloud certification.
* ITIL Foundation Certification.
* Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto, or other network security certifications are an added advantage.



  





**Who will excel \-** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

title: Disaster Recovery Engineer
description:
Cloud Disaster Recovery Engineer Experience: 5+ years 
 Role Overview : 
 The Disaster Recovery Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions to ensure the organization's technology infrastructure and critical systems can withstand and recover from disruptions. This role involves hands-on work with disaster recovery strategies, high availability (HA) architectures, automation, and failover solutions in on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The ideal candidate will have expertise in disaster recovery, IT resilience, and infrastructure engineering, working closely with IT operations, cybersecurity, and business continuity teams to enhance the organization's overall technology resilience posture. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Disaster Recovery Engineering & Technology Resilience: 
 Develop and maintain disaster recovery (DR) solutions, ensuring that IT systems meet defined recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO). Design, implement, and maintain highly available (HA) and fault-tolerant architectures across on-premises, cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid environments. Implement automation and orchestration for disaster recovery and failover processes using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and scripting tools (Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python). Work with IT infrastructure and application teams to integrate resilience best practices into system design, deployment, and operations. Perform failure mode analysis (FMA) to identify and address system vulnerabilities. 
 Disaster Recovery Testing & Validation: 
 Design and implement fully automated disaster recovery runbooks using Ansible and Python using one-click or event-triggered failover systems. Develop automated recovery verification (post-failover health checks). Develop and execute disaster recovery drills and failover testing, identifying gaps and improvements. Automate DR testing, validation, and reporting. Conduct regular validation of backup and replication strategies, ensuring data integrity and availability. Monitor system failover and recovery performance, optimizing configurations to improve response times. 
 Incident Response & Crisis Management Support: 
 Act as a technical lead during disruptions and disaster recovery events, ensuring rapid system recovery. Work closely with cybersecurity teams to integrate DR solutions with cyber resilience strategies, ensuring quick restoration from ransomware or cyberattacks. Support post-incident analysis and recommend improvements to resilience strategies. 
 Monitoring, Compliance & Reporting: 
 Implement and maintain resilience monitoring tools, ensuring continuous tracking of system availability and DR readiness. Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, FFIEC, SOC 2). Provide technical input for audits and regulatory assessments related to technology resilience. Generate reports on resilience testing results, failover performance, and risk mitigation efforts. 
 Collaboration & Training: 
 Work closely with IT teams, business continuity professionals, and cloud architects to ensure resilience strategies align with business needs. Provide training and technical guidance to IT staff on disaster recovery best practices and system failover configurations. Assist in the development of technical documentation and playbooks for disaster recovery and resilience processes. 
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in disaster recovery, resilience engineering, IT infrastructure, or cloud engineering with disaster recovery as the primary area of focus. Expertise in disaster recovery planning and high-availability (HA) solution design. Hands-on experience with backup, replication, and data protection solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, Zerto, Azure Site Recovery). Hands-on experience with cloud resilience strategies (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native DR tools. Hands-on experience automating AWS disaster recovery using:
a. Boto3 for orchestration of EC2, RDS, S3, Route 53, IAM, AWS Backup, and EDRS.
b. Cross-region replication and failover strategies.
c. AWS-native DR patterns (pilot light, warm standby, multi-region active/active).
d. Automation of AMI lifecycle, backup validation, and restore testing. Advanced automation engineering experience, including:
a. Designing and maintaining enterprise-scale Ansible automation frameworks (roles, collections, dynamic inventories, Ansible Automation Platform/AWX).
b. Developing production-grade Python automation using Boto3.
c. Building event-driven automation workflows for failover and recovery.
d. Implementing idempotent Infrastructure as Code (IaC) patterns.
e. Integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins). Knowledge of networking, storage, virtualization, and hybrid-cloud architectures. Cloud automation and orchestration at scale is a supporting requirement for this position. Candidates must bring demonstrable experience in coding and scripting of cloud resources in AWS and other cloud environments, applied to disaster recovery outcomes. 
 Certifications: 
 Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), or Disaster Recovery Certified Specialist (DRCS) AWS Certified Solutions Architect Red Hat Certified Engineer Microsoft Azure Administrator

Key Skills: AWS,Boto3,Python,Disaster Recovery,Cloud Resilience,S3,EDRS,Veeam

* This role requires a strong background in enterprise\-grade routing and switching (including extensive experience with Cisco IOS/IOS\-XE/NX\-OS operating systems), the comprehensive Juniper Mist AI\-driven wireless platform, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, SD\-WAN, advanced AWS cloud networking (including Gateway Load Balancer, Transit Gateway, VPC Peering, and sophisticated traffic management techniques), and in\-depth Zscaler Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solutions (including Zscaler Internet Access \- ZIA and Zscaler Private Access \- ZPA).
* You will play a critical role in ensuring the stability, security, and scalability of our enterprise network, including the physical infrastructure of our network distribution frames, and effectively communicating network strategies and issues across the organization.
* This role requires participation in an on\-call rotation to provide 24x7 support.


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications:**
* 8\+ years' total experience
* Design, configure, implement, and maintain enterprise\-level network infrastructure, including routers, switches (campus and data center), firewalls, wireless access points, and related services.
* Design, implement, and manage complex BGP routing solutions, including iBGP/eBGP peering, route reflectors, policy\-based routing, traffic engineering using communities and other attributes, and troubleshooting complex BGP convergence and stability issues.
* Lead the design, build\-out, and ongoing management of Main Distribution Frames (MDFs) and Intermediate Distribution Frames (IDFs), ensuring adherence to structured cabling standards, optimal cable management, power distribution, cooling, and physical security.
* Design, deploy, and manage the Juniper Mist AI\-driven platform (including Mist Access Points, Mist Edge, and the Mist Cloud dashboard for AI\-driven operations, Marvis Virtual Network Assistant, Wi\-Fi Assurance, Wired Assurance, and WAN Assurance).
* Deploy, manage, and optimize Palo Alto Networks' SD\-WAN, firewalls, including policy creation, threat prevention, VPN configuration, and performance tuning.
* Architect, build, and manage secure and scalable network solutions within AWS cloud environments, including:
* Designing and implementing AWS Transit Gateway architectures for large\-scale network connectivity (VPC attachments, Direct Connect Gateway, route propagation, network segmentation, and policy enforcement).
* Setting up and managing AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) for deploying and scaling third\-party virtual appliances.
* Establishing and managing VPC Peering connections (intra\-region and inter\-region) ensuring secure and optimized communication paths.
* Implementing comprehensive AWS traffic management solutions using services like Route 53 (DNS, health checks, routing policies), Elastic Load Balancing (ALB/NLB), and AWS Direct Connect for hybrid connectivity.
* Configuring and managing Security Groups, Network ACLs, and other AWS native security features.
* Implement, configure, and manage Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions, including:
* Setting up and managing identity provider (IdP) integrations (e.g., SAML, SCIM) for robust user authentication and the creation/management of identity\-based security policies and access groups.
* Deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Zscaler Private Service Edges (PSEs) for optimized and secure access to internal applications via ZPA.
* Developing and contributing to Business Continuity Plans (BCP) for Zscaler services, ensuring resilient and continuous secure access for users.
* Configuring traffic forwarding, security policies, and application segments.
* Lead network infrastructure projects from conception to completion, including requirements gathering, design, planning, execution, and post\-implementation support, ensuring clear communication with all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor network performance and integrity using tools like Marvis for proactive insights, identify and resolve complex network issues (leveraging deep troubleshooting skills for routing, switching, firewalling, cloud networking, and SASE solutions), and implement proactive measures to prevent outages and performance degradation.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, IDF/MDF layouts, Zscaler policy and architecture details, operational procedures, and present technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Effectively collaborate and communicate with cross\-functional teams (Security, Systems, Applications, DevOps, Facilities) to ensure network infrastructure supports business requirements and strategic initiatives.
* Perform network capacity planning and recommend upgrades and enhancements to meet evolving business needs, articulating justifications and benefits clearly.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for after\-hours support and respond to critical network incidents, providing 24x7 operational support as needed, communicating status and resolution effectively.


**Other Qualifications:**
* Stay current with emerging network technologies, security threats, and industry best practices.
* Mentor junior network engineers and provide technical guidance and support, fostering their communication and technical skills.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CCNP (Enterprise/Data Center/Security), CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure/Security), JNCIP\-ENT, Juniper Networks Certified Mist AI Specialist (JNCIS\-MistAI) or Professional (JNCIP\-MistAI), PCNSE, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP\-PA, ZCCP\-IA) or Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA\-PA, ZCCA\-IA).
* Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Ansible) for network tasks, including AWS CloudFormation or Terraform for infrastructure as code.
* Knowledge of SD\-WAN technologies.
* Familiarity with other cloud platforms (Azure, GCP).
* Experience with network segmentation and micro\-segmentation strategies.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Position ID: J0926\-0534  

Work Type: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

Role Overview:
  

We are looking for an experienced API Management Engineer with 5–8 years of experience to design, implement, and support a highly available and secure enterprise API Management platform.  

  

The role will focus on API Gateway, API policies, security, analytics, caching, messaging, and high availability architecture across EMEA and AMER regions. The candidate will work closely with architects, developers, DevOps, security, and application teams in an Agile delivery environment.  

  

Core Technical Competencies
  

. API Management / API Gateway – Strong experience in enterprise API gateway implementation, configuration, routing, throttling, transformation, and lifecycle management.  

. Control Plane – Experience with API policy administration, API configuration, monitoring, and analytics.  

. Data Plane – Hands on experience managing distributed API Gateway environments across multiple regions.  

. Azure API Management – Strong knowledge of Azure API Management services, policies, products, subscriptions, APIs, and backends.  

. API Security – Strong understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, TLS 1\.3, authentication, authorization, and API security best practices.  

. High Availability – Experience designing Active Active, stateless, multi region API architectures.  

. Azure Cache – Experience with distributed caching, transient data, read only caching, and cache management.  

. Azure Service Bus – Experience with queues, asynchronous messaging, retry mechanisms, and event driven integration.  

. REST APIs – Strong understanding of RESTful API design, integration, versioning, and lifecycle management.  

. API Monitoring \& Analytics – Experience with API metrics, logging, monitoring, alerts, and performance analysis.  

. DevOps / CI/CD – Experience automating API deployment and configuration using CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
  

  

Key Responsibilities  

. Design, configure, and maintain enterprise API Management and API Gateway platforms.  

. Manage API Gateway deployments across EMEA and AMER using highly available Active Active architecture.  

. Configure API policies for security, authentication, authorization, throttling, routing, transformation, and error handling.  

. Implement secure API access using OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, and TLS 1\.3\.  

. Manage API lifecycle including onboarding, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and retirement.  

. Configure and optimize Azure Cache for transient and read only data scenarios.  

. Implement Azure Service Bus queues for asynchronous API and application communication.  

. Configure API monitoring, analytics, logging, dashboards, and alerts.  

. Troubleshoot API gateway, integration, performance, and connectivity issues.  

. Implement automation for API configuration and deployments through Azure DevOps CI/CD.  

. Ensure API solutions meet enterprise security, performance, scalability, and availability standards.  

. Collaborate with Architects, Developers, Security, DevOps, QA, and business teams.  

. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.  

  

Good to Have
  

. Experience with Azure API Management Premium / multi region deployments.  

. Knowledge of Azure Application Gateway, Front Door, Key Vault, and Entra ID.  

. Experience with Terraform / ARM / Bicep for Infrastructure as Code.  

. Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.  

. Experience with API testing tools such as Postman.

title: Team Lead, CAE
description:
**Your Job**
As a **Tech Lead for Thermal \& High\-Power Systems** , you will provide hands\-on technical leadership to a multidisciplinary simulation team solving complex thermal challenges across data center, high\-power connectivity, liquid cooling, automotive, and industrial applications.


You will combine deep expertise in thermal engineering and CFD with the ability to guide engineers, establish simulation standards, review complex models, and coordinate critical technical programs. You will play an important role in advancing Virtual Product Qualification by enabling simulation\-led product development, reducing dependence on physical prototypes, and improving the speed and confidence of engineering decisions.
  

**Our Team**


The Global Engineering Services Multiphysics Simulation Group supports Molex businesses worldwide through predictive engineering, simulation, and Virtual Product Qualification. The team works across thermal and CFD, structural mechanics, signal integrity, electromagnetic compatibility, and multiphysics domains, with a strong focus on data center and high\-power applications.
  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Provide technical leadership for complex thermal and CFD simulation programs involving liquid\-cooled cold plates, manifolds, microchannels, heat exchangers, air cooling, immersion cooling, and high\-power connector systems.
* Lead the technical execution of thermal simulation programs for data center product lines such as OSFP, QSFP, co\-packaged optics, power connectors, and backplane systems.
* Review simulation methodologies, assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, material properties, convergence criteria, and results to ensure physics fidelity and engineering credibility.
* Guide engineers in conjugate heat transfer, thermal resistance modeling, pressure\-drop analysis, flow\-distribution optimization, junction\-temperature prediction, and thermal interface material characterization.
* Serve as a technical mentor to simulation engineers by strengthening their problem\-solving capabilities, engineering judgment, and understanding of thermal and fluid physics.
* Coordinate the technical work of a multidisciplinary simulation team, establish work priorities, remove technical roadblocks, and promote effective collaboration across thermal, structural, SI, and EMC disciplines.
* Establish and continuously improve standards, templates, quality gates, and best practices for thermal and high\-power simulation deliverables.
* Drive validation and correlation of CFD and thermal models against physical test data, while clearly communicating prediction confidence, model limitations, and areas of uncertainty.
* Partner with product, systems, design, and test engineering teams to define simulation requirements and identify thermal risks early in the product development lifecycle.
* Support simulation\-led qualification and NPI programs by balancing technical rigor, product risk, and program timelines.
* Contribute to reduced\-order models, surrogate models, Digital Twins, and AI/ML\-enabled approaches for thermal prediction and real\-time temperature estimation.
* Investigate emerging thermal\-management technologies, including direct liquid cooling, two\-phase cooling, phase\-change materials, and advanced cold\-plate architectures, and assess their relevance to Molex products.
* Communicate complex thermal findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders through clear recommendations, design insights, and business\-relevant outcomes.
* Demonstrate the value of simulation through prototype reduction, thermal\-risk mitigation, qualification\-cycle compression, design optimization, and NPI cost reduction.
* Promote a team culture grounded in scientific integrity, technical curiosity, constructive challenge, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning from simulation and validation results.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Master's or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Sciences, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics, or a closely related engineering discipline, with substantial academic or professional work in thermal or fluid dynamics.
* Ten or more years of engineering experience in thermal analysis, CFD, heat transfer, or multiphysics simulation, including experience providing technical leadership, project leadership, or mentorship to engineers.
* Hands\-on experience using thermal and CFD tools such as Ansys Fluent, Ansys CFX, Simcenter STAR\-CCM\+, or an equivalent commercial simulation platform.
* Experience with high\-power electronic systems involving liquid cooling, cold plates, heat exchangers, thermal interface materials, conjugate heat transfer, electronics cooling, or data center cooling architectures.
* Experience leading technically complex, cross\-functional simulation programs and communicating engineering results, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Experience with data center products or technologies such as OSFP, QSFP, co\-packaged optics, high\-density connectors, power distribution modules, servers, racks, or system\-level thermal management.
* Knowledge of liquid\-cooling and electronics\-cooling standards or guidelines, including ASHRAE, OCP, and JEDEC.
* Experience with cold\-plate design, microchannel flow, pressure\-drop optimization, flow\-uniformity analysis, or two\-phase thermal\-management technologies.
* Experience conducting electro\-thermal simulation for high\-current connectors, EV charging systems, industrial power distribution, or HPC power\-delivery networks.
* Experience developing reduced\-order thermal models, Digital Twins, surrogate models, Physics\-Informed Neural Networks, or AI/ML\-based thermal prediction methods.
* Experience correlating simulation results with laboratory testing and defining confidence levels or uncertainty bounds for thermal predictions.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, facilitate technical reviews, build reusable engineering knowledge, and improve simulation practices across teams.
* Familiarity with Koch's Principle\-Based Management philosophy or an equivalent principled operating framework.

title: Process Design Engineer (Pipeline Hydraulics)
description:
Total Number of Openings


1
Develops and optimizes systems in operating and production facilities for separation, purification, transformation, transportation, and sale/disposition of hydrocarbons, water and contaminants. Focuses on the interaction of fluids with equipment in meeting required compositional specifications, physical conditions, and flow rates.
  

  

Manages group and employee work to align with corporate/department objectives. Direct reports are typically individual contributors.
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

  

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

 **About the position**

  

The Process Design Engineer – Specialty Operations Infrastructure will be a member of the Process Engineering team at Chevron ENGINE. This role performs hydraulic modeling, transient analysis, and water hammer studies to support Chevron’s Specialty Operations assets and infrastructure projects (brownfield and greenfield), with an emphasis on safe, reliable, and operable process designs. The position supports pipeline integrity, operational reliability, regulatory compliance, project development and asset optimization by developing hydraulic models, evaluating transient scenarios, assessing surge risks, and recommending practical mitigation solutions. The role also encompasses pressure relief system calculations, overpressure protection, and related process safety support.

  

Engineers will work closely with Operations, Pipeline Integrity, Projects/Project Engineering, Process Engineering, Control Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Maintenance, and other discipline engineers to support facility designs, modifications, and ongoing operational needs. The Process Design Engineer (Pipeline Hydraulics) will interface directly with Chevron assets and project teams to provide technical ownership, evaluation support, and remote engineering assistance across the Specialty Operations Infrastructure portfolio.

  

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.

 **Key responsibilities**

  

* Perform Hydraulic and Transient Analysis – perform transient hydraulic, surge and water hammer analysis for liquid and multiphase pipeline systems. Conduct studies for pipeline startups, shutdowns, valve operations, emergency events, relief events and abnormal conditions. Evaluate transient pressure profiles and identify locations susceptible to overpressure, slack conditions, vapor collapse or excessive negative pressure.
* System Modeling and Data Management – gather, validate and maintain hydraulic model inputs. Develop baseline operating configurations and model various operating scenarios, calibrate and validate models against operating data to ensure accuracy and reliability, maintain current models for operating assets and future projects.
* Develop, review, and maintain hydraulic modeling documentation including relief valve information, equipment datasheets, design basis narratives, control narratives, and other technical documentation as required.
* Surge Mitigation and Risk Reduction – identify potential surge and water hammer hazards, evaluate and recommend mitigation measures. Provide engineering recommendations that improve safety, reliability and operability.
* Regulatory and Compliance Support – ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards including pipeline pressure management requirements.
* Reporting and Technical Documentation – Develop comprehensive engineering reports documenting assumptions, configurations, scenarios, surge analysis results and mitigation recommendations. Prepare technical presentations and communicate findings to all parties (engineering, operations, leadership, and project stakeholders).
* Ensure designs comply with Chevron engineering standards, applicable industry codes, and regulatory requirements.
* Support development of process design criteria and standard methodologies for Specialty Operations Infrastructure; support Management of Change (MOC) activities with appropriate technical documentation and engineering justification.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 5\+ years of experience in hydraulic modelling, pipeline engineering, process engineering, or related field supporting crude oil, refined products, NGL, water and multiphase pipeline systems
* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering (or similar) from an appropriately accredited university.
* Experience performing transient hydraulic, surge or water hammer analysis.
* Knowledge of ASME B31\.4, ASME 31\.8, API RP 1130, and 49 CFR Parts 192 and 195
* Proficiency with process modeling tools such as SPS (Synergi Pipeline Systems), OLGA, and/or industry\-recognized transient calculation methods.
* Familiarity with ASME, API, and other applicable industry codes and standards related to pressure relief and process design.
* Knowledge of core process design deliverables including process design basis, process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P\&IDs), and heat and material balances.
* Knowledge of Chevron or similar corporate engineering standards and management of change (MOC) processes.
* Experience supporting HAZOP, LOPA, MOC, and incident investigation activities.
* Experience with Python, VBA, SQL, or other data analytics tools
* Ability to communicate effectively with operations, project teams, and multiple engineering disciplines.
* Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools such as PI, SEEQ, or similar platforms.

 **About you**

  

We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–10 years of process engineering and process design experience within renewable fuels, petroleum refining, specialty chemicals, or related process industries.
* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, or equivalent, from an appropriately accredited university.
* Proficiency with process simulation tools such as Pro II and/or Aspen HYSYS.
* Proficiency with iPRSM PSV/relief system calculations \& database.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting biodiesel, renewable diesel, or other alternative or low carbon fuels facilities.
* Experience with batch, semi batch, and continuous process units involving reaction, separation, and treating systems.
* Strong knowledge of process design practices, deliverables, and project execution phases.
* Familiarity with ASME, API, and applicable industry codes and standards.
* Working knowledge of HAZOP facilitation, process safety analysis, and root cause analysis.
* Experience supporting brownfield projects and operating facilities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across functional teams and with asset stakeholders.
* Experience and working knowledge with relief system calculations and standards, i.e. API 520, API 521, ASME Sec VIII, Chevron FRS\-DU\-5056, and FRS\-DU\-5057\.

 **What we can offer you**

  

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

  

Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well\-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.

title: Warehouse Associate
description:
**Location:** Unit No. 02, Level 5, Creator Building, ITPB,  
Whitefield Road, Bangalore\-560066, Karnataka

**About Sycomp**

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state\-of\-the\-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 100 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring a **Warehouse Associate** to support our operations at our Mumbai facility. This role is critical in ensuring accurate inventory management, efficient warehouse operations, and seamless handling of IT materials across our global logistics network. You’ll work closely with internal teams to maintain high operational standards in a fast\-paced, process\-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive and process incoming materials with accuracy and efficiency
* Ensure proper storage, identification, and location tracking of inventory
* Handle RMA (Return Material Authorization) processes following established procedures
* Maintain warehouse organization and cleanliness aligned with 5S standards
* Pick, pack, and fulfil orders in line with quality and packaging standards
* Ensure accurate documentation and timely system data entry
* Monitor and maintain inventory accuracy (system vs physical stock reconciliation)
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to support operational requirements
* Identify efficiency improvements and support process optimization initiatives
* Manage packing and stationery materials to ensure uninterrupted operations

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree (any discipline)
* 5\+ years of experience in warehouse or inventory operations
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling inventory
* Experience with warehouse processes, stock control, and documentation
* Ability to work in a structured, process\-driven environment
* Good communication and teamwork skills

*Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

*Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at careers@sycomp.com*

*Sycomp may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience. These tools assist our teams, and all hiring decisions are made following human review.*

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable working in an onsite setting?
* Do you have experience handling RMA (Return Material Authorization) processes?
* Years of hands\-on experience in picking, packing, and order fulfilment?
* Do you have experience using warehouse systems (WMS/ERP) for inventory tracking and data entry?
* How many years of experience do you have in warehouse or inventory operations?
* Years of experience maintaining inventory accuracy and performing stock reconciliation (system vs physical)
* Have you worked in a warehouse environment following 5S or similar operational standards?
* What is your expected annual salary (in INR)?
* Notice Period (in days)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Language:

* fluent English (Required)
* Kannada (Required)

Location:

* Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: R&D Associate Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R \& D Hub Manager, India **Your role and responsibilities:**


In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the strategic technology direction by contributing your own ideas for identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative technology, software and solutions. Each day, you will assist the Research and Development (R\&D) team by executing your assigned tasks and using technical knowledge in a structured way. You will also showcase your expertise by staying abreast of the state of the art and actively applying this knowledge.


This role is contributing to the Motion business IEC LV Motors division in Bangalore India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Coordinate \& work with cross functional team for prototype development and testing .Knowledge of IS/IEC standards, Regulations \& International Standards
* Monitoring technology developments and ABB products and technologies, and identifying technical drivers for R\&D projects
* Working to improve operations and increase customer satisfaction according to incoming requests, and providing consulting services to business operations and customers
* Participating in working teams, disseminating technical/scientific knowledge in projects, and assisting colleagues in applying processes and tools
* Participating in networks to expand knowledge of the targeted area of expertise
* Training team members, Production/Quality/technician when needed, and heading up or participating in projects

* B.E or B. Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 5 \- 6 years of experience in R\&D / Engineering.
* Must have worked with electrical rotating machines design.
* Exposure in electrical rotating machines with R\&D/Engineering.
* Good communication skills.
* Experience of various electrical design tools and software's.

**More about us:**


The IEC Low Voltage Division is a technology leader delivering a full range of energy\-efficient low voltage motors, including ultra\-efficient solutions such as IE5 SynRM (synchronous reluctance motors). title: Environmental Consultant
description:
WSP has an exciting opportunity for an Environmental Consultant to join our large and growing team of environmental professionals in India. The role will be based within the UK Environmental Management and Assessment (EMA) team, which is part of our wider Planning and Consents business.


The role would suit an enthusiastic individual looking to deliver environmental elements of engineering projects, within a wide range of sectors including transmission \& distribution, rail, highways, energy and commercial / residential, from feasibility through to planning, including detailed design and construction.


You will have responsibility for preparing technical reports, preparing proposals, project delivery, and financial management.


You will be joining a well\-respected and leading global environmental consulting team with a wide range of clients across different markets and sectors including national and local government, industrial, commercial and scientific sectors. You will be integrated into the UK EMA team and will be supported in your professional career development with opportunities for training, mentoring and chartership.


  
The successful applicant would be responsible for many of the following:


* Working with, and coordinating multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver environmental inputs into projects
* Preparing and reviewing written input into technical environmental reports
* Undertaking desk\-based environmental assessments
* Author chapters/report for large scale environmental projects including (EIA, SEA, CEMP, etc.)
* Support the career development of more junior colleagues in the India team
* Supporting senior colleagues with ad\-hoc project tasks
* Monitoring of deliverables/projects against scope, budget and programme

  
Key Competencies / Skills


Essential Skills


We would love to hear from you if you have these essential skills:


* Have an appropriate academic qualification in an environmental, or related discipline (Bachelor's degree or Preferably Master's degree)
* Have about 4 to 6 years’ experience in environmental consultancy, ideally with Environmental Impact Assessment experience
* Are ambitious and appreciate the responsibilities associated with undertaking work in highly technical subject areas
* Have strong communication skills including fluent written and verbal English with report writing skills, such as experience of Environmental Impact Assessment chapter writing
* Have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical data and prepare clear reports.
* Should be able to explain and present highly technical subject matters in a way that is logical and understandable – using plain English
* Are a good team worker with excellent and demonstrable attention to detail
* Are confident and highly motivated, with good and proactive communication skills and the ability to work independently, as well as part of a team
* Are able to demonstrate a sensible and proactive approach to project work
* Are willing to help support, mentor junior team members
* Collaborative mindset and outcome driven working method

Desirable Skills


* Knowledge of the UK planning process and UK environmental legislation
* UK experience and/or UK Professional Memberships in the environmental sector will be an added advantage
* Knowledge on Environmental Assessment process for on\-shore and off\-shore wind energy projects and infrastructure projects
* Experience working for a global environmental consultancy
* Energy sector and/or highways experience, particularly for large\-scale infrastructure projects
* Strategic Environmental Assessment and/or Environmental and Social Impact Assessment experience
* Experience of producing socio\-economic inputs for Environmental Impact Assessments
* Robust project management, time management and financial management skills.

title: Sr Engineer- Network
description:
Xperi invents, develops and delivers technologies that create extraordinary experiences at home and on the go for millions of people around the world. Powering billions of consumer electronics, connected cars and digital content titles, we make entertainment more immersive, driving more intelligent and every interaction seamlessly personalized through our renowned consumer brands: DTS®, HD Radio™, and TiVo®.


Xperi (NYSE: XPER) is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in San Jose, CA with over 1800 employees across North America, Europe and Asia. Come join a thriving team where you can play an integral role in shaping the future of entertainment technology.


The All In Media team at Xperi provides solutions to radio stations across the world. These include broadcast systems, mobile apps, integrations with Sonos, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and digital ad monetization solutions. Our studio broadcast system, Rapid, has recently won the NAB Product of the Year award, and is used to by hundreds of radio stations across the world. We have released over 500 apps, and dominate the UK, Irish \& Australian markets.


We work with several major radio groups across the world, including the ABC, BBC, Bauer, Global Radio, Cumulus, MediaCo, New York Public Radio, Nova Entertainment, and SBS.


About the role:


Join a team that is dedicated to support and create the world class Network environment which is highly available and resilient. As Senior Network Engineer you’ll play a role to support company wide network environments as part of Global IT team. Enjoy the opportunity to draw on your passion for problem\-solving and simplifying tasks, as well as your technical skill set to make important contributions to the environment.
