title: Staff Engineer, Embedded S/W (Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer )
description:
Req ID: 81864
Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, India


In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are seeking a **Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer** to join our cable access engineering team, co\-developing directly with our US\-based systems architects, software and hardware teams.
  

In this specialized role, you will design and maintain firmware for next\-generation Full Duplex (FDX) Cable Amplifiers and smart RF nodes. Rather than Ethernet switching, your focus will be at the intersection of embedded Linux, Broadcom broadband SoC platforms, dynamic RF control loops (AGC, tilt, gain), and modern cable plant telemetry via gNMI, Protobuf, and MQTT.


**How will you help us connect the world:**
* Broadcom Cable SoC Integration: Develop low\-level firmware using Broadcom SDKs tailored for Broadband/Cable Access SoCs to initialize, configure, and monitor digital/analog RF processing hardware.

 RF Control \& Signal Processing: Implement embedded control loops for Automatic Gain Control (AGC), Automatic Level Control (ALC), tilt adjustment, dynamic power management, and echo cancellation in Full Duplex RF amplification stages. Hardware Interfacing \& Bus Management: Control on\-board peripherals, RF attenuators, equalizers, power amplifiers, and environmental sensors over I2C, SPI, and GPIO interfaces.
* Linux Kernel \& Low\-Level Driver Development: Write and maintain custom Linux kernel drivers, character devices, and user\-space daemons interacting directly with hardware registers and memory\-mapped I/O.
* Streaming Telemetry \& Remote Management: Architect modern out\-of\-band management and monitoring agents using gNMI (gRPC Network Management Interface), Protobuf (Protocol Buffers), JSON, and MQTT for real\-time health and RF performance metrics.
* US Co\-Development \& Technical Collaboration: Actively participate in joint design reviews, code reviews, and architectural planning with US\-based firmware, RF hardware, and systems engineering teams.
* Hardware Bring\-Up \& Validation: Perform board bring\-up on custom Broadcom SoC evaluation boards and production amplifier hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and RF spectrum analyzers.

**Required Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

* Experience: Preferably 5\+ years of hands\-on embedded software/firmware development experience in modern C and C\+\+.


* Cable / RF Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of RF fundamentals, dynamic signal management, and Automatic Gain Control (AGC) control loops in amplified RF transmission paths (e.g., DOCSIS / Cable TV plants).


* Broadcom Broadband SoC \& SDK: Hands\-on experience developing with Broadcom SoCs and SDKs (broadband/RF access platforms) at the register and hardware abstraction levels.
* Embedded Linux \& Bus Protocols: Deep experience with Embedded Linux driver development, Linux networking internals, and low\-level peripheral buses (I2C, SPI, UART).
* Telemetry \& Serialization: Practical experience implementing gNMI, Protobuf, JSON, and MQTT connectivity for dynamic device configuration and streaming telemetry.
* US Collaboration: Proven track record collaborating effectively with US\-based or distributed engineering teams; excellent technical English communication skills and ability to align on US working hours.

title: Field Test Engineer – RF / Anti-Drone / GNSS Systems
description:
**Field Test Engineer – RF / Anti\-Drone / GNSS Systems**

Location : Bangalore

Experience : 3 \- 8 yrs

Salary : 6 \-7 LPA

We are looking for an experienced Field Test Engineer with hands\-on experience in RF detection, RF jamming, Anti\-Drone systems, GNSS jamming/detection systems, RF Detectors and electronic\-warfare\-related equipment.

The candidate will be responsible for installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, field trials, performance evaluation and customer\-site support of RF\-based Anti\-Drone, GNSS Jammer, RF Detector and related systems.

The role involves extensive travel to customer locations, operational sites, test ranges and field\-trial locations for installation, acceptance testing, demonstrations, troubleshooting and evaluation of new equipment.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**Installation \& Commissioning**

* Install and commission RF Anti\-Drone Jammers, GNSS Jammers, RF Detectors, RF Surveillance and associated systems at customer and field locations.
* Install RF equipment, antennas, RF cables, power supplies, control units and communication interfaces.
* Verify system configuration, antenna connections, grounding, power supply and communication links.
* Perform system\-level checks after installation and ensure equipment is ready for operation.

**Field Testing \& Trials**

* Conduct field testing and performance evaluation of RF detection and jamming systems.
* Participate in customer demonstrations, qualification trials, acceptance tests and operational field trials.
* Execute approved test plans and customer requirements.
* Perform RF measurements and verify frequency coverage, signal strength, detection range, jamming effectiveness and system response.
* Record test results, observations and anomalies and prepare field\-test reports.

**Troubleshooting \& Maintenance**

* Diagnose and troubleshoot RF systems, antennas, RF cables, power supplies, communication interfaces and control software.
* Identify hardware, RF and system\-level faults during field deployment.
* Perform fault isolation and coordinate with design, production and engineering teams for corrective action.
* Carry out system reconfiguration, calibration and replacement of faulty modules where required.

**Customer \& Field Support**

* Travel to customer locations, defence establishments, test ranges and field locations as required.
* Support customer demonstrations and technical presentations during field trials.
* Interact with customer engineering, technical and operational teams.
* Provide on\-site technical support during deployment and operational trials.

**New Product Testing**

* Participate in testing and evaluation of new RF / Anti\-Drone / GNSS / Detection and Jamming equipment.
* Develop and execute test procedures for new equipment.
* Verify equipment functionality against specifications and requirements.
* Identify design issues and field\-level problems and provide feedback to R\&D/product\-development teams.

**3\. Required Technical Skills**

**RF Engineering**

* Strong understanding of RF fundamentals and wireless communication systems.
* Knowledge of RF propagation, antennas, transmission lines and RF link budgets.
* Understanding of frequency, bandwidth, modulation, power levels, sensitivity, noise and interference.
* Ability to interpret RF measurements and analyse spectrum plots.

**RF Detection**

* Practical knowledge of RF signal detection, spectrum monitoring, RF signal identification, direction\-finding concepts, signal\-strength measurement, RF interference analysis and detection\-range testing.

**RF Jamming**

* Knowledge of RF jamming principles, GNSS jamming concepts, RF interference/denial, jamming\-effectiveness evaluation, frequency coverage, power requirements and antenna systems.

**Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS**

* Understanding of RF\-based drone detection and identification, RF jamming/mitigation, GNSS\-based drone navigation concepts and Counter\-UAS system architecture.

**4\. Test Equipment Knowledge**

Candidates should be comfortable operating or learning to operate: Spectrum Analyzer, RF Signal Generator, RF Power Meter, Vector Network Analyzer (VNA), Oscilloscope, Multimeter, Frequency Counter, VSWR/Return Loss Measurement Equipment, RF Attenuators, Couplers, Loads, Directional Antennas, RF Cables and Connectors.

**5\. Qualification**

Essential: B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications or Electrical \& Electronics Engineering.

Preferred: Experience in Defence Electronics, RF Systems, Electronic Warfare, Counter\-UAS, RF Surveillance, Spectrum Monitoring, RF Detection or Jamming Systems.

**6\. Experience**

Preferred Experience: 3–8 Years.

Candidates with hands\-on experience in RF Detection Systems, RF Jamming Systems, Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS Systems, GNSS Detection/Jamming Systems, RF Surveillance, Electronic Warfare Systems, Spectrum Monitoring, RF Communication Systems, Defence Electronics, RF Test \& Measurement, or Antenna Testing and RF Integration will be strongly preferred.

Candidates who have participated in field trials, customer installations and troubleshooting of RF systems will be given preference over candidates with only theoretical RF knowledge.

**7\. Behavioural \& Field Skills**

* Strong hands\-on troubleshooting ability.
* Ability to work independently at customer and field locations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work under pressure during field trials and demonstrations.
* Good communication and customer\-interaction skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India and, if required, internationally.
* Ability to prepare clear and technically accurate test reports.
* Ability to coordinate with R\&D, production, quality and project teams.
* Good documentation and reporting discipline.

**8\. Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with RF detection and/or jamming equipment and understand how such systems behave in real\-world environments.

Preference will be given to candidates who have previously worked on: RF Detector → RF Detection → Signal Analysis → RF Jamming → GNSS Jamming → Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS → Field Trials → Customer Installation → Troubleshooting.

Candidates should be capable of independently carrying out a site visit, understanding the RF environment, setting up test equipment, conducting tests, identifying faults and reporting results to the engineering team.

**9\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Successful installation and commissioning of field systems.
* Timely completion of field trials and customer demonstrations.
* Accuracy and completeness of test reports.
* Effective troubleshooting and reduction of repeat field failures.
* Successful resolution of customer\-site technical issues.
* Compliance with approved test procedures and safety requirements.
* Quality of technical feedback provided to R\&D and engineering teams.
* Customer satisfaction during installation and field support.

title: Subsea Controls Engineer
description:
Total Number of Openings


1
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.


Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.


About the position


The Subsea Controls Engineer is part of the Subsea team within Chevron ENGINE. The Subsea Controls Engineer will be responsible for providing engineering support for the long\-term management of subsea controls system equipment (including manifolds, trees, instrumentation, flowmeters, SCMs, subsea chokes, HPUs, EPUs, CDUs, communications, and distribution systems) for subsea production systems. Primary focus areas are electro/hydraulic controls, instrumentation (pressure, temperature, flow, rate control, etc.), automation, project management, local and international contractor’s management, hazard evaluation, reliability assessment, system performance monitoring, maintaining regulatory compliance, and minimizing potential operating downtime. The incumbent supports the operations team in an engineering capacity with the technical maintenance, troubleshooting, assessments, intervention planning, and offshore execution related to subsea production systems. Incumbent shall ensure safe reliable operations that meet all applicable standards and engineering best practices and develop company's know\-how in this area. Support and work with the Subsea and Operations team members daily.


Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.


Job Description

* Provides advanced design verification support for Chevron projects worldwide, assisting with pipeline concept development, pre\-FEED, FEED, risk assessments, detailed design, procurements, fabrication, qualification testing, installation, pre\-commissioning, and creating integrity management plans to ensure reliable pipeline systems.
* Support and managing bidding processes, evaluating contractor proposals, assessing their technical capabilities, and supervising their execution when necessary.

**Job Summary**


We are seeking a Test Manager with 15\+years of experience in leading quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will own functional, automation, performance, scalability, reliability, and release\-readiness strategy across cloud\-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical devices, and EMR/EHR integrations. This role combines people leadership, test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, and audit\-ready verification delivery.

### **What you’ll be doing**

* Define and continuously improve the functional, automation and performance verification strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, and release plans.
* Lead functional, automation and performance engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability.
* Establish test governance, risk\-based planning, estimation, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality metrics, dashboards, and release\-readiness assessments.
* Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C\#\-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test\-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration.
* Ensure stable daily smoke tests, staged regression execution, automated quality gates, baseline performance tests, and scheduled release\-level suites within CI/CD pipelines.
* Guide validation of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real\-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems.
* Partners with product, clinical, systems, architecture, development, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies and quality risks.
* Drive root\-cause analysis by correlating automation and performance results with application logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry.
* Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post\-market learnings, and production trends into regression, reliability, and performance coverage.
* Maintain audit\-ready plans, cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, and validated test\-management systems.
* Communicate quality status, risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, automation value, performance findings, and go/no\-go recommendations to program and leadership forums.

### **What you’ll bring**

* B.E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics \& Communication / Electrical or related field
* 15–18 years of software testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading technical teams in a regulated or safety\-critical environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end\-to\-end regression using C\#/.NET, Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies.
* Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk.
* Experience validating distributed microservices, event\-driven systems, REST and GraphQL APIs, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies.
* Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role\-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability.
* Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, test reporting, and management dashboards.
* Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence.
* Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real\-time communication technologies.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance\-threshold evaluation.
* Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure\-as\-code, service virtualization, and container security.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post\-market investigations, and enterprise\-scale healthcare product releases.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software.
* Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release\-readiness reviews.
* ISTQB, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous.

title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Job Summary  

We are looking for a detail\-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands\-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.  

  

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.  

Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Rack Installation \& Cabling  

* Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
* Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
* Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self\-resolving outside approved procedures
* Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities


Rack Lifecycle Operations  

* Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
* Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as\-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
* Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self\-resolve outside approved procedures
* Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre\-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation


Material Handling \& Supply Chain Support  

* Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
* Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
* Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines


Handover \& Documentation  

* Complete all required as\-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign\-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
* Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
* Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase


Rack Decommissioning  

* Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de\-tagging, and rack extraction
* Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
* Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
* Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post\-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
* Validate that reclaimed U\-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool


Quality, Safety \& Compliance  

* Adhere to all site\-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
* Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
* Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity


Cross\-Team Coordination  

* Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
* Participate in daily stand\-ups and pre\-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
* Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately


Continuous Learning \& Development  

* Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
* Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team\-specific technical programs
* Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
* Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
* Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

  

A day in the life  

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de\-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands\-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS
  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance
  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  

  

Inclusive Team Culture
  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* High school or equivalent diploma

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Strong understanding of **DHCP, DNS, and AAA services**.
* Familiarity with **VPN, VLAN, Wi\-Fi security, WPA3, and 802\.1X**.
* Knowledge of network monitoring tools such as **SolarWinds or Nagios**.

* Basic knowledge of **Windows and Linux server administration**.
* Experience with ticketing and incident management tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

* Experience developing, maintaining, and running automated testing tools.

Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient design. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.


**Competencies:**



Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems \- Specifies electronic hardware and interconnections that measure and control systems; applies electronic hardware and interconnections in Cummins' products.



Machine Integration and Optimization \- Combines various parts or sub\-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem\-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.



Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.



Product Problem Solving \- Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.



Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.



System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.



Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.



Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.



Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.



Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.



Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.



Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.



Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.



Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.



Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls \- Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.



Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.



This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred

title: Senior Consultant - GIS
description:
WSP is seeking an experienced GIS Consultant to join our multidisciplinary team supporting the US Earth \& Environment (E\&E) Business Line. The GIS consultant will provide advanced expertise in geospatial analyses, environmental data management, and cartographic support for projects related to site investigation and remediation, power generation and distribution, environmental impact assessments, environmental planning and permitting, and other similar areas.


The team you will join offers an exciting diversity of projects and clients. You will lead delivery and ensure technical excellence across all phases of the project. The role will be based in either Bengaluru or Noida.


  
* Effectively execute GIS workflows for power \& energy and environmental projects, from data acquisition, digitizing, processing, analyses, QA/QC and final cartographic delivery, with minimal supervision
* Design, manage, and maintain scalable project geodatabases, including schema development, metadata standards, and long\-term data stewardship.
* Produce defensible GIS analyses and presentation\-quality cartographic products (maps, drawings, figures, charts, posters, etc.) for diverse audience including clients, regulators, engineers, and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Conduct constraint, sensitivity, and impact analyses for routing and siting studies, translating complex environmental data into decision ready outputs.
* Lead development of map design, scale, symbology, and data limitations to prevent misinterpretation or misuse of GIS outputs.
* Implement mobile GIS and field data collection workflows, including data validation, post\-processing, and enterprise integration.
* Configure and maintain ESRI web mapping environments (e.g., ArcGIS Online and/or enterprise portal) to support project teams, including publishing layers, organizing web maps, and controlling permissions/roles.
* Maintain high standards of data quality management, including QA/QC procedures, error detection, and documentation of assumptions and limitations.
* Manage multiple concurrent assignments while meeting consulting budgets, schedules, and quality expectations.

  
Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in Geography, GIS, Geoinformatics, Geology, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.

title: Group Lead IT, Platform Engineering
description:
Job Description Job Title: Group Lead IT, Platform Engineering Band: 11 Location: Bangalore, India Reports to: Paul Eastman, Head of Product Platforms Engineering (PPE) Job Summary Kraft Heinzs Product Platforms Engineering (PPE) organisation is building a single, India-based Platform Engineering capability that brings our DevOps and Quality Engineering platform teams together under one leader. This is a brand-new leadership role: you will design, build and run the team, the toolset and the operating model from the outset, rather than inherit an established function. The mission of the Platform Engineering function is to make it fast, safe and easy for every engineer at Kraft Heinz, human or AI-assisted, to build, test and run high-quality digital products. You will own the full platform stack end to end: CI/CD, project management, observability, and the Quality Engineering and test automation toolset. You will define the platforms strategy, service catalogue and governance, and you will lead a growing India-based team of managers and engineers, working closely with our delivery partner HCLTech under our "Autonomous Operations" model. This role sits on the PPE leadership team alongside the Product Engineering Chapter Lead and the Power Platform Lead, and is directly accountable for modernising a large technology estate, and aligning platform delivery to Kraft Heinzs Reference Architecture. Key Responsibilities Platform Strategy Governance Own and evolve the strategy for the combined DevOps and Quality Engineering platform, defining the service catalogue, availability, configuration and release lifecycle for each capability. Govern the platforms that enable Kraft Heinzs engineering community to build, test, deploy and operate digital products, and be accountable for service performance definition, measurement and reporting. Drive rationalisation of a toolset that currently spans 20+ tools and technologies, making deliberate, evidence-based decisions on where to consolidate and where to invest, in line with our Capable, Lean Healthy strategy. Align platform architecture and controls to Kraft Heinzs Reference Architecture Team Leadership Talent Development Build, structure and lead the India-based Platform Engineering team from the ground up, starting with the Testing Platform Manager and DevOps Platform Delivery Manager as direct reports, growing the function toward its target headcount over time. Recruit, coach and develop platform and test engineers, establishing Kraft Heinz as a location of choice for platform engineering talent in India. Set clear objectives, career pathways and performance standards for the team, fostering a culture of ownership, engineering excellence and continuous improvement. Act as a member of Paul Eastmans PPE leadership team, contributing to organisation design, workforce planning and cross-chapter initiatives beyond the immediate platform remit. DevSecOps Toolset Ownership Ensure the smooth, secure operation of the DevSecOps toolset, including CI/CD (e.g. GitHub, Azure DevOps), security and compliance tooling (vulnerability scanning, secrets management) and monitoring/logging tooling (e.g. PagerDuty, New Relic, Grafana). Collaborate with development teams and the Software Engineering chapter to ensure DevSecOps capabilities are seamlessly integrated into the software development lifecycle. Work with the security team to ensure the platform meets organisational security policy and regulatory requirements. Quality Engineering Test Transformation Own the Quality Engineering and test automation toolset - test case management, test automation, performance/load testing and test optimisation - and drive its modernisation. Lead the transformation of a large legacy manual test estate toward AI-powered, automated test orchestration, addressing known gaps such as automation script generation for legacy tooling. Evaluate and implement new QE and test orchestration tools and technologies, building the business case and driving adoption of best practice across the organisation. Delivery Partner Stakeholder Management Manage day-to-day delivery and performance of HCLTech and other service partners against the "Autonomous Operations model, ensuring scalable, secure and integrated services that Product teams can trust. Work closely with Global IT and other PPE chapters to ensure new initiatives with up/downstream impact on the platform are coordinated and aligned. Represent the platform in governance forums and executive updates, communicating strategy, risk and progress clearly to senior stakeholders. Service Operations Performance Execute platform governance - routines, controls and monitoring - and continuously improve them to drive better performance. Own incident, problem and change management for the platform, ensuring reliable, well-supported services for the engineering community. Manage delivery of new platform features, integrations and capabilities in line with the platforms roadmap and PPEs wider strategy. Requirements 8+ years of experience in IT/engineering, including significant experience in DevOps, platform engineering or quality engineering leadership roles. Proven people leadership experience, including managing managers and building or scaling a team, ideally within an international or offshore/India delivery model. Hands-on experience with enterprise DevSecOps tooling, with a preference for GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence. Working knowledge of Quality Engineering and test automation tooling (e.g. HP ALM/Worksoft, Selenium, LoadRunner, test optimisation platforms such as Panaya or LiveCompare). Proven experience of platform management, including: Defining platform strategies Scaling platforms in an internationally distributed environment Implementing platform governance Assessing and selecting platform technologies Broad technology experience beyond platform management, including project scoping and delivery, requirements analysis, solution/process design, systems administration and solution architecture. Experience managing outsourced or managed-service delivery partners against agreed service levels. Experience with cloud platforms, with a preference for Microsoft Azure (including AKS/Container Apps). Strong understanding of security and compliance principles, with experience implementing security controls and monitoring for vulnerabilities. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience operating credibly with senior (VP/CIO-level) stakeholders. Experience of working in diverse global teams and as part of large matrix organisations. Nice to Have Exposure to AI-assisted software delivery - e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or similar agentic engineering tooling - and an interest in AI-native ways of working. Experience with AI-powered test orchestration or self-healing test automation platforms. Certification in DevSecOps, Quality Engineering, or an IT service management framework (e.g. ITIL). Experience with agile delivery at scale (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, SAFe). Knowledge or experience gained from within the CPG industry would be an advantage. Qualifications - Soft Skills Empathy - you listen more than you talk, understand your internal customers deeply, and use that understanding to improve their experience of the platform. Ability to Simplify - you keep things simple and move fast, translating complex challenges into simple, adoptable solutions. Proactive - you are a self-starter who drives initiatives through to completion and is comfortable challenging the status quo to get the right result. Analytical - you use data to guide decisions, translating complex information into clear, actionable recommendations. Communication Skills - you communicate clearly and confidently in writing and verbally, including with senior leadership. People Leadership - you build trust quickly, develop talent, and create an environment where engineers do their best work. Project Programme Management - you are organised and structured, and can bring multiple large-scale initiatives to a successful conclusion within agreed timeframes. Location(s) Bengaluru - Brookfield GCC

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Overview**
**Job Description**
**Department:** 
 Technology – Infrastructure \& Network Operations
   

  

**Team:** 
 Network Operations
   

  

**Title:** 
 Network Engineer
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Network Engineer is a core member of the Network Operations team responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing HealthEdge’s enterprise network infrastructure across on\-premises data centers, cloud environments, and remote access platforms. This role operates within a team\-driven model emphasizing 24/7 availability, ITIL\-aligned processes, automation, and measurable operational outcomes in support of our healthcare SaaS platform.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
**Technical Execution \& Operations**
* Design, configure, and maintain LAN/WAN, SD\-WAN, VPN, firewall, and load\-balancing infrastructure across multi\-site and multi\-cloud environments
* Monitor network performance (SolarWinds, Datadog, ThousandEyes) and proactively resolve issues before they impact service delivery and SLA targets
* Implement network security controls including firewall rule sets, IDS/IPS, segmentation, NAC, and zero\-trust architecture principles
* Design and manage AWS network infrastructure — VPCs, subnets, route tables, IGW, NAT Gateways, and ELBs — for scalable, highly available architectures
* Configure AWS Transit Gateway and VPC peering for secure, low\-latency connectivity across accounts, regions, and on\-premises environments
* Implement AWS Direct Connect and Site\-to\-Site VPN for hybrid connectivity between HealthEdge data centers and AWS
* Administer AWS Route 53 including private hosted zones, resolver rules, and health\-check\-based routing policies
* Manage AWS Security Groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and AWS Shield for least\-privilege access and DDoS protection
* Leverage AWS CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, and AWS Network Manager for observability, traffic analysis, and anomaly detection
* Support Azure or GCP networking as required — VNets/VPCs, peering, and hybrid connectivity


**Incident Response \& Change Management**
* Participate in 24/7 on\-call rotation, triaging and resolving network incidents per SLA targets; contribute to post\-incident reviews to drive MTTR reduction
* Execute network changes through established change management processes; serve as Tier 3 escalation resource for complex issues


**Automation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Develop automation scripts and IaC (Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python) to improve monitoring, alerting, and network deployment workflows
* Build and maintain IaC for AWS network resources enabling repeatable, auditable deployments; surface optimization opportunities across the team’s roadmap


**Documentation \& Collaboration**
* Maintain topology diagrams, runbooks, IPAM, and change records; support DR testing, vendor coordination, and legacy environment consolidation
* Collaborate across Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Application teams; mentor junior team members


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Network Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on enterprise network engineering or network operations experience
* Strong knowledge of routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP)
* Experience with enterprise firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco ASA/FTD)
* Demonstrated AWS networking expertise: VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, Security Groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall
* Proficiency with network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Datadog, PRTG, or similar)
* Experience with SD\-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet, or equivalent)
* Solid understanding of DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SSL/TLS, and PKI
* Hands\-on experience with IaC and automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python)
* Familiarity with ITIL\-based incident, problem, and change management processes
* Excellent analytical and communication skills; ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE, NSE, or AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Experience in healthcare SaaS or regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2\)
* Experience with large\-scale infrastructure integrations or M\&A network consolidation
* Familiarity with HealthEdge products (HealthRules® Payer, HealthEdge Source™, GuidingCare®, Wellframe™)
* Network automation experience at scale in a 24/7 operations environment

title: Network engineer
description:
**About Us**
 The Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), established in 1958, is one of India's premier institutions for science, engineering, and technology education and research. Recognised as an Institution of Eminence by the Ministry of Education, IIT Bombay consistently ranks among the top universities globally.
   

  

 Home to world\-class faculty, cutting\-edge research facilities, and a vibrant academic community, IIT Bombay's Computer Centre provides the critical IT infrastructure that powers teaching, research, high\-performance computing, enterprise applications, cloud services, and digital operations across the Institute. The team is responsible for designing, operating, and continuously improving one of India's leading academic technology environments.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Computer Centre at IIT Bombay is seeking a Network Engineer to join its infrastructure and operations team. This is a highly hands\-on technical role for an experienced network engineer who enjoys designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving enterprise, campus, and datacentre networks. The selected candidate will play a key role in operating network infrastructure supporting teaching, research, high\-performance computing (HPC), AI/ML workloads, enterprise applications, and digital operations across the Institute.
   

  

 This role is not a purely managerial, coordination, or vendor\-management position . We are looking for an engineer who remains deeply involved in network configuration, deployments, migrations, troubleshooting, automation, and day\-to\-day operational problem\-solving.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Network Engineering \& Infrastructure Design, deploy, and maintain highly available enterprise, campus, and datacentre networks, including routing, switching, VLANs, VRFs, and segmentation. Configure and troubleshoot BGP, OSPF, high\-availability architectures, wireless infrastructure, and network connectivity. Execute network deployments, migrations, upgrades, lifecycle refreshes, and infrastructure expansion, working directly with network hardware, optics, fibre, and cabling.
   

  

 Network Operations \& Incident Response Monitor network availability, reliability, performance, and capacity across production environments. Troubleshoot complex network incidents and lead root\-cause analysis across routing, switching, Wi Fi, security, and transport layers. Maintain operational standards, including incident reports, change records, SOPs, network diagrams, and preventive measures.
   

  

 Network Security \& Access Configure and maintain firewalls, VPNs, ACLs, NAC systems, and network security controls. Implement network segmentation, access control, and security hardening across campus and datacentre environments. Collaborate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to identify and remediate network security risks.
   

  

 Network Automation \& Technical Leadership Develop automation for network configuration, monitoring, inventory, and operational tasks using Python/Shell, Ansible, or equivalent tools. Implement monitoring, telemetry, logging, and observability using SNMP, Syslog, Net Flow/s Flow, and related technologies. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical standards, network architecture, and long\-term infrastructure planning.
   

  

 Desired Experience \& Skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. 5–9 years of strong hands\-on network engineering experience in enterprise, campus, datacentre, or similarly complex production environments. Strong practical expertise in advanced routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, high\-availability architectures, network segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, and enterprise Wi Fi . Demonstrated experience personally executing complex network deployments, migrations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation. Experience with Python and/or Shell scripting, Ansible or equivalent automation tools, Git\-based workflows, network monitoring, telemetry, and observability . Experience with Cisco, Arista, Juniper, or equivalent enterprise networking platforms is preferred. Experience with EVPN\-VXLAN, MPLS, spine\-leaf datacentre fabrics, NAC/802\.1 X, Zero Trust architectures, and Net Box/IPAM/DCIM systems is desirable. Experience supporting research, HPC, AI/ML, or large academic/campus environments is an advantage. Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, Arista ACE , or equivalent certifications are preferred. Equivalent demonstrable hands\-on expertise will also be considered.
   

  

 Please note: This is a Mumbai\-based, on\-campus role at IIT Bombay. This is a hands\-on engineering position and candidates whose experience is primarily limited to network coordination, vendor management, reporting, or people management without substantial implementation and troubleshooting exposure may not be suitable. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

1### **The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Centre (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy** **challenges. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.**

It combines marine engineering, technical assurance, voyage operations, commercial support, and reliability expertise with a state\-of\-the\-art marine training centre with simulator capability also being commissioned. 	+ ### **Cost efficiency improvements versus traditional models.**
* ### **Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, safety, and reliability.**

* ### **Effective marine training centre delivering high\-quality, compliant training courses**
* ### **Strong alignment with shipping leadership and global stakeholders**
* ### **A scalable, repeatable, and cost\-competitive capability model supporting future ENGINE growth.**

### **Leadership expectations**

	+ ### **Directness, accountability, and results focus**
	+ ### **Strong decision\-making and ownership mindset**
* ### **Build a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning**
* ### **Act as a visible leader and integrator across ENGINE and shipping’s global model**
* ### **Drive talent development, mentoring, and succession planning**
* ### **Lead through change, growth, and capability transformation**

### **Why this role matters**

* ### **ENGINE Shipping has rapidly expanded in scope and complexity, requiring dedicated leadership to ensure effective governance, scalable delivery, and long\-term capability development for the marine function.**
* ### **This role establishes the foundation for a locally led, globally supported shipping capability, enabling sustainable growth and operational excellence.**

### **Required qualifications:**

### **Experience \& capability**

* ### **Extensive and broad experience across shipping, marine operations, and/or maritime training; with a target of more than 10 years in Chief Engineer / Master Engineer role.**

* ### **Track record in building capability and scaling operations**
* ### **Strong understanding of training governance, compliance, and accreditation frameworks**

description:

Job Description:
About Fuels \& Low Carbon Technology: Fuels and Low Carbon Technology is s team of over 300 technologists, scientists and engineers who provide pioneering solutions to support bp’s Fuels, Refining, Bioenergy and Hydrogen businesses. We also support the Technology group through Innovation Management, Modelling, Digital Sciences and our academic research programmes.
The Bioenergy \& Hydrogen Technology team (B\&HT) will bring together scientists and engineers dedicated to delivering low carbon energy solutions that align with bp’s strategy while also supporting the technological needs of our oil and gas projects. The team works across bp’s businesses supporting areas such as novel feedstocks, biofuels and advanced biofuels, and hydrogen.
About the role:
The Scale\-Up team in Bioenergy \& Hydrogen Technology develop, de\-risk and scale up novel processes in the bioenergy and hydrogen value chains. This is a senior role within Scale\-Up, to provide technical leadership across bp especially in the field of thermodynamics and physical properties. Your line manager will be the India Engineering Manager, and you will be a part of the multidisciplinary engineering and science team based in our Bengaluru office, India.
What you will deliver:
Leader by example through safe and compliant operations, contributing to the development of a strong HSSE culture, including psychological safety.
Lead purposeful process design, development and modelling work that clearly supports programme outcomes, peer review other programmes, and communicate results effectively to diverse customers.
Represent bp in internationally leading consortia and joint industry projects, challenging and steering research, and bring these insights and challenges back into bp.
Develop and manage the company's physical property data capabilities
Build positive relationships with bp's businesses and engineering teams to identify high\-impact thermodynamics and physical properties challenges, to provide targeted advice and underpin future programmes.
What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)
A PhD in thermodynamics modelling, thermal/transport property measurement or related fields with a strong grasp of the underlying fundamentals, or demonstration of equivalent experience – likely min. 12 years of professional experience
Experience in scaling new process technologies from early experiments through to pilot / demonstration scale operations, focussing on key technical and commercial risks.
Deep understanding of risk analysis (technical and business) and appropriate decision making, techno\-economic modelling, and safety principles
Application of applied thermodynamics modelling, including into process simulations \- ASPEN\+ or similar
Skillful use of modelling studies to influence and shape internal experimental and academic programs to deliver improved business outcomes, including operational and design optimisations
Strong leadership, mentorship and communication skills.
Good to have experiences/skills:
Prior technology knowledge and practical experience in renewable / low carbon fuels and related larger unit operations. Examples include fixed bed reactors, hydrogen / syngas production, fermentation, biogas production, ethanol production, and carbon\-capture.
Chartered Engineer or equivalent
Practical, large scale experience in a chemicals, biofuels or refining manufacturing environment.
Thorough understanding of numerical methods and solution algorithms, and experience of solving challenges with sophisticated process simulation physical property bases
Physical property estimation and prediction in industrially relevant applications, process and product design, including decarbonisation technologies e.g. modeling of CO2 capture, transport, and storage
Heat and mass transfer knowledge, and ability to communicate efficiently with the CFD / multi\-physics modelling community.
Travel – up to 25%. Travel between the various locations (in the UK, US, China, and India) and universities (in the UK, India, Continental Europe and the US) may be periodically required.

title: Technical Training Instructor
description:
### **Job Summary**



The Technical Training \& Dealer Capability Development Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, development, and delivery of technical training programs that strengthen the capability of dealer service engineers and service network personnel. This role focuses on enhancing product knowledge, troubleshooting expertise, service quality, and customer handling skills while ensuring compliance with Cummins standards, safety requirements, and operational excellence. The position works closely with cross\-functional teams and dealership partners to build a skilled service network that delivers exceptional customer support and business performance.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Develop, coordinate, and deliver technical training programs for dealer service engineers and service personnel to improve product knowledge, troubleshooting capability, technical proficiency, and customer service skills.
* Assist senior technical trainers in the preparation, delivery, and continuous improvement of classroom, virtual, and hands\-on technical training programs.
* Complete product qualification requirements and continuously develop expertise on Cummins products, systems, and technologies.
* Update and maintain training materials, participant handouts, instructor guides, and training documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency across training centers.
* Communicate training material updates and best practices to regional training teams and relevant stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Service, Sales, Technical Support, Engineering, and Dealer Development to align capability\-building initiatives with organizational objectives.
* Partner with dealerships to ensure the availability of qualified technical manpower and support workforce capability planning based on required skill sets.
* Establish and implement structured technical training and certification programs to improve service engineer competency, repair quality, and troubleshooting effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning by promoting ongoing technical development, certifications, and participation in relevant learning programs.
* Conduct regular audits of dealership service centers to evaluate repair quality, adherence to Cummins service processes, and compliance with operational standards.
* Ensure dealership personnel follow Cummins safety requirements, standard operating procedures, compliance guidelines, calibration requirements, and proper usage of standard service tools.
* Support training administration activities including maintaining training records, attendance, certifications, and learning documentation.
* Coordinate training equipment, tools, and inventory to ensure effective execution of training programs.
* Monitor training effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement in dealer capability development initiatives.
* Build strong relationships with dealers, customers, and internal stakeholders to enhance service capability and customer satisfaction.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Education, Business, or a related discipline.
* Additional technical certifications or training qualifications are advantageous.
* Ability to obtain any licenses required for export control or regulatory compliance, where applicable.

### **Skills**


* Knowledge of technical training delivery methodologies and adult learning principles.
* Strong understanding of technical service operations, dealer network management, and capability development.
* Ability to develop and deliver engaging technical and customer service training programs.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting techniques, service quality standards, and repair processes.
* Familiarity with Cummins products, systems, and service procedures is preferred.
* Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess training effectiveness and identify capability gaps.
* Planning, organization, and project coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and learning management systems.
* Customer\-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Ability to adapt training delivery to different audiences and learning environments.
* Strong commitment to health, safety, compliance, and quality standards.

### **Experience**


* Minimal to early\-career experience in technical training, learning and development, field service, dealer support, or a related technical function.
* Experience assisting with training preparation, delivery, or learning administration is preferred.
* Exposure to dealer service operations, technical support, or customer service environments is advantageous.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and external partners is desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to build technical knowledge and support capability development initiatives through training and coaching.

title: Advanced Electrical Engineer
description:
**Make your ability count at NNE**


We are experts in end\-to\-end pharma engineering, and our success is built on our relationships, both with our colleagues and our customers. If you want to work on projects shaping the future of sustainable and intelligent pharma facilities, NNE is the place to be.


**Why should you join us?**


**Why should you join Facility design team:**


* You get to work with extremely passionate pharma engineers and global experts that brings up a great exposure to your competencies and career growth.
* Joining the Facility Design team gives you the exposure to work on the future proof state\-of\-art API facilities in Denmark which are largest in the world.
* We collaborate closely with our colleagues in Denmark, providing opportunities for employees to work on\-site there (need\-based).
* Our diversity \& inclusion initiatives nurture an inclusive culture where our differences drive innovation and empower us to unleash the potential of everyone.
* We believe the power of diversity can only be unlocked when we have an inclusive culture where all employees feel valued and have a sense of belonging.
* We also welcome suggestions from new hires with a variety of specialties to expand on our joint accomplishments.

**Why should you join Electrical team:**


We are looking for determined and dedicated experienced Electrical Engineers to ensure that our customers receive the best\-in\-class electrical consultancy for their projects, ranging from conceptual design to installation and commissioning.
  

  

We are a digital player, using our own tools in conjunction with large plant systems to create early studies, design solutions, and specifications for our clients. We offer an exciting project environment that allows you to continue growing with new ways of working, such as using SIMARIS tool to design the electrical network and other electrical tools to execute fast\-track projects and ensure the right electrical installations.
  

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India
  

**Seniority:** 8\-10 years
  

**Department** Electrical
  

  

**How you might spend your days (Main Roles \& Responsibilities)**
  

  

As Advanced Electrical Engineer, you'll be working with a motivated, multi\-disciplinary team where, you'll be:
  

Supporting a group of colleagues preparing engineering/technical project tasks


* Coordinate technical work.
* Set out technical directions.
* Technical trouble shooting.
* Preparing design specifications and supporting the selection and procurement of electrical equipment/components.
* Tendering and contract work.
* Executing projects in the construction phase by supervising contractors and suppliers.
* Planning and controlling FAT/SAT activities.
* Providing support to leads on complex project challenges and electrical design within the building/process electrical segment:
* Electrical equipment sizing and power calculations
* Electrical distribution for upstream and downstream system
* Cable sizing and short circuit calculations
* Knowledge on international standards such as IEC, ATEX, etc.
* Risk assessment studies for electrical safety
* Knowledge on control circuit design for MCCs and IMCCs
* Supporting the development of our Electrical Engineering System through standardization.
* Developing and designing engineered solutions to complex problems through individual contribution and/or by support the teams of engineers

**Who you are (Preferred Competencies)**


We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the effort we do as a team. As a person, you:


* Thrive in a workday that can bring both dynamic and complex work, which sometimes can be unpredictable when working on projects
* Can communicate information in a transparent and precise manner to both your manager and colleagues as well as customers and other relevant stakeholders
* Can manage tasks and team in a structured way
* Are curious and openminded to learn new things
* Have a positive approach and can be persistent when facing challenges
* Should be willing to relocate to Project Sites on need basis

**The miles you’ve walked (Education and Work Experience)**


In all positions there are some things that are needed, and others a bonus. We believe these qualifications are needed for you to do well in this role:


* You have at least eight years of experience working as a Advanced/Engineer with electrical design, installations, and other related engineering challenges.
* You have worked as an Senior, providing rationale for technical solutions.
* You have GMP experience from the process, pharmaceutical, or life science industry.
* You have a degree in electrical engineering or a similar technical field.

**We’re experts bound by a noble cause and driven by passion**


NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more. Some of us are driven by working on highly complex projects together with other leading experts. Others are inspired by a work environment with flat hierarchy and flexible conditions. And some love the fact that they work for a world leading engineering consultancy within the pharma industry. If there's one thing, we all share, it's the passion for what we do. Together we design and build pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients all over the world.
  

Sounds like something you’d like to do? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.
  

  

**Deadline of application is** Month date year – 15th Oct 2026


Questions before applying? Please contact PVYN@nne.com

title: Senior AL ML Trainer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate Senior Technical Trainer with good hands\-on to join our expert team. Candidate will drive knowledge adoption across customers, partners, and internal teams delivering high\-impact training in AI/ML, Deep Learning, and the rapidly evolving Generative AI \& Agentic AI landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Conduct engaging in\-person and virtual training sessions across a range of learner profiles

· Deliver workshops and bootcamps on AI/ML, Deep Learning, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI systems and LLMOps.

· Design and develop training materials, including slide decks, hands\-on labs, demo notebooks, video walkthroughs, and assessments aligned towards current industry trends and customer needs.

· Build modular, reusable learning content covering GenAI application development, RAG architectures, LLM fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, and multi\-agent orchestration, LLMOps.

· Integrate real\-world use cases and project\-based learning into every module, ensuring practical applicability.

· Work closely with internal and external Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to draft training proposals and curate content aligned with enterprise skilling goals.

· Train and mentor internal trainers and partner faculty to scale delivery across regions and formats.

**Requirements (Must\- have):**

· ML and Deep learning frameworks: Scikit Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras

· Neural network architectures: CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers

· ML workflows: data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and optimization

· Working knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs): GPT, Llama, Mistral, Gemini, Claude, etc.

· Prompt Engineering: zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, and advanced prompting patterns

· RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate), embedding models, chunking strategies

· LLM Fine\-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, RLHF

Agentic AI \& Frameworks:

· Building and teaching AI Agents — tool use, memory, planning, and reasoning loops

· Hands\-on familiarity with at least two or more Agentic AI frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen (Microsoft), OpenAI Agents SDK or Anthropic Claude SDK

· Hands\-on knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, and function calling patterns

· Hands\-on knowledge of Multi\-Agent system design and its nuances and LLMOps

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience

· Demonstrated hands\-on experience in AI/ML model development, GenAI application building, or data science workflows

· Proven track record of delivering technical training, workshops, or bootcamps especially in AI/ML or GenAI domains

· Experience with cloud\-based AI/ML platforms (AWS Sagemaker, Azure AI Foundry, GCP Vertex AI, etc.) is highly recommended.

· Having any of professional cloud certifications is a plus

· Prior experience developing content for professional certifications or enterprise skilling programs is a plus

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

· Strong facilitation skills \- comfortable engaging beginners as well as seasoned engineers in the same session

· Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an eye for real\-world applicability

**Good to have:**

· Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or public learning resources (blogs, notebooks, talks)

· Experience with AI governance, responsible AI practices, or bias/safety considerations in LLMs

· Active community presence (LinkedIn, Hugging Face, GitHub, etc.)

**What We Offer:**

· Competitive salary and performance bonuses.

· Learning \& development opportunities.

· Collaborative and diverse team environment.

· Be a part of the ONLY company in the world to be recognized by Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud with prestigious awards in 2025\.

* Execute the deployer role in the ontology change pipeline — technical execution of approved changes
* Carry production on\-call responsibility for critical infrastructure

**Required skills:**

* 6–12 years in platform or infrastructure engineering, strong hands\-on Kubernetes expertise (AKS)
* Hands\-on Neo4j cluster operations — deployment, scaling, backup/restore, failover
* Infrastructure as Code — Terraform or equivalent, production\-grade implementation
* CI/CD pipeline build and operation — Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent
* Strong Azure networking and security fundamentals
* Comfortable owning production on\-call for critical infrastructure

* Prior work in a Tier\-0 / mission\-critical availability environment
