title: Playback Ops Sys Dev Engineer, Playback Operations Systems Group
description:
**Description**
 Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
   

  

 Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add\-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast\-paced, growth business \- available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
   

  

 Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results\-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast\-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
* Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems — identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
* Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
* Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
* Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
* Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise—latency spikes, availability drops—you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly.
   

  

 Mid\-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events.
   

  

 Afternoons bring cross\-team collaboration—troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high\-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Playback Ops Systems Group build and maintain reliable, high performance customer experience monitoring tooling and infrastructure. We take ownership of the end\-to\-end live monitoring experience \-\- from a Living Room device, through our encoding and analysis platform, out through to our Live Ops AVOCs (Amazon Video Operation Centres). Our team makes a big impact because nothing is more important to us than delighting our customers, continually earning their trust, and thinking long term. If you crave a sense of ownership, this is the place to be.

* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience with distributed systems at scale


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment
* Experience establishing metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence
* Experience in major facilities incident management
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment
* supporting or automating physical device fleets, encoding appliances, or hardware infrastructure

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **Job Description**
-------------------


**Site Engineer \- External Civil**


The **Site Engineer \- External Civil** is responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and executing all external civil and infrastructure works in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules. The role involves managing construction activities related to site grading, earthworks, roads, pavements, kerbs, drainage systems, stormwater networks, underground utilities, culverts, retaining structures, hard landscaping, fencing, utility corridors, and external infrastructure associated with the project. The engineer shall review construction drawings, method statements, technical specifications, and survey data to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable standards.


Key responsibilities include coordinating with consultants, clients, subcontractors, survey teams, and utility agencies to ensure smooth execution of external works and timely completion of project milestones. The engineer shall monitor site activities, manage manpower, equipment, and materials, conduct inspections, verify line, level, and alignment, and resolve technical issues affecting project progress. Additional duties include supervising excavation, backfilling, compaction, road construction, drainage installation, utility crossings, and site development works while ensuring adherence to approved methodologies and specifications.


The Site Engineer shall prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, monitor quantities and productivity, maintain site records, coordinate quality inspections, and ensure compliance with project quality plans and HSE requirements. The role also includes supporting testing activities such as field density tests, concrete testing, drainage testing, and utility inspections, as well as assisting in project handover and preparation of as\-built documentation.


Experience in **Data Centre, Industrial, Infrastructure, Commercial Building, Township Development, or Large\-Scale Construction Projects** is preferred. The candidate should possess strong knowledge of earthworks, roadworks, drainage systems, underground utilities, surveying principles, construction sequencing, and relevant IS, ASTM, BS, and local authority standards. A **Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering** with 3**\+ years of relevant experience** in external infrastructure and civil construction works is required. Strong technical, planning, coordination, problem\-solving, and communication skills are essential for ensuring safe, high\-quality, and timely delivery of external civil infrastructure works. Project is HYD123\&124\.

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high \& low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  

  

Incident Management.
  

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management \& Fault Management.
  

  

Vendor Management.
  

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors \& security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem \& conflict management when dealing with same.
  

  

Process Improvement.
  

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process \& a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

The ideal candidate will be responsible for network operations, troubleshooting, implementation, optimization, and maintaining high availability across the network infrastructure.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Technical Responsibilities**


1\. ConfigureConfigure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise networks using Cisco and FortiGate equipment.


* Perform network configuration, upgrades, and troubleshooting across colocated datacenter environments.


2\. Layer 2 / Layer 3 design \& troubleshooting


* Handle design, implementation, and troubleshooting of STP, RSTP, VTP, VLANs, HSRP, and VRRP.
* Troubleshoot complex L2/L3 connectivity and performance issues.


3\. BGP, OSPF \& routing governance


* Manage BGP sessions on ASR, route\-maps, route\-policies, and AS\-path policies.
* Configure and troubleshoot OSPF and failover routing strategies.
* Ensure stable and optimized routing across the network infrastructure.


4\. VPN solutions \& remote access


* Implement and manage VPN solutions including Site\-to\-Site, SSL, and IPSec.
* Manage remote access policies and troubleshoot VPN connectivity issues.


5\. High availability — MLAG, VPC, Port\-Channel


* Configure and maintain high\-availability network infrastructure using MLAG, VPC, and Port\-Channel technologies.
* Troubleshoot redundancy and failover\-related issues.


6\. Firewalls, ACLs \& FortiGate UTM


* Configure and maintain firewalls and ACLs for network security and segmentation.
* Work with advanced FortiGate UTM features.
* Troubleshoot firewall policies, traffic flow, and security\-related network issues.


7\. Vendor \& cross\-team collaboration


* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for network upgrades, migrations, troubleshooting, and major incident resolution.
* Manage vendor support and coordinate resolution of infrastructure\-related issues.


8\. Root cause analysis \& optimization


* Perform RCA for recurring and critical network issues.
* Identify opportunities for network optimization, performance improvement, and infrastructure upgrades.


9\. Documentation \& topology upkeep


* Maintain comprehensive and up\-to\-date documentation of network topologies, configurations, and SOPs.
* Ensure network changes and configurations are properly documented.


 **Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of hands\-on enterprise networking experience.
* Strong command of L2/L3 protocols and enterprise networking standards.
* Proven expertise with Cisco IOS / NX\-OS and FortiOS.
* Deep hands\-on experience with BGP, OSPF, VPN, STP, VTP, and VLAN planning.
* Solid grounding in MLAG, VPC, and high\-availability network designs.
* Demonstrated ability to handle complex routing / firewall troubleshooting and major incident resolution.
* Proficiency with network monitoring tools (Observium, NetFlow, SNMP).
* CCNP / CCIE and/or NSE certification preferred (CCIE or NSE4\+ strongly preferred for this level).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Must Have**


* Exposure to datacenter interconnect, VXLAN, EVPN, or SD\-WAN.
* Experience with automation using Python or Ansible for network tasks.
* Experience managing vendor SLAs and contract\-based network support.


**Experience\- 5\-8 yr of exp**


**Shift\- Rotational**


**Reports To\- Director**


**Department\- Network Infrastructure**


**Location\- Pune**

It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System.  Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 SYSTRA is a dynamic international consulting and engineering powerhouse in India, driving innovation across critical infrastructure sectors including Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for both public and private sectors.
   

  

 We pride ourselves on our unparalleled expertise, consistently delivering cutting\-edge technical solutions that transform infrastructure landscapes. Our comprehensive, end\-to\-end services leverage industry\-leading methodologies to ensure project success.

 Systra is appointed to provide Project Management Consultancy Services for Works of Signalling \& Telecommunication System, SCADA System, and Ticketing System Of Mumbai – Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project
   

  

**We Are Seeking Applications**
**Position:** 
 Section Engineer\-Telecommunication System
   

  

 Hiring for Project Management Consultancy Services for Works of Signalling \& Telecommunication System, SCADA System, and Ticketing System of Mumbai – Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahemedabad/Delhi
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

 Assist Chief Expert and Dy. Chief Expert in performing tasks that includes the following but not limited to:
   

  

* Assist in Design review of Telecom System including sub systems for backbone of data transmission from field units to centralized control centres (DTS), Wireless Network, CCTV, Access Control, PIDS, PAS, Master Clock, EPBAX, Telecom SCADA etc.
* Assist in Installation, Integration, Testing \& Commissioning of Telecom System.
* Assist in Interfacing of Telecom System with Rolling Stock, Signalling Subsystems, MEP, SCADA etc. and Interface document approval.
* Assist in verifying completed work and prepare request for payment to contractors.
* Assist NHSRCL in obtaining statutory approvals.
* Assist and coordinate with various agencies i.e. ISA, CMRS etc. for successful completion of the project.
* Assist in any other roles and responsibilities required to be performed to complete the project and assigned by PD and Client(NHSRCL).


 Profile/Skills
   

  

**Min. Qualification:** 
 Engineering Graduate (B.E/B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical / Electronics stream or equivalent )
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Engineering Graduate with 07 years, or Engineering Diploma with 10 years of experience of implementing Telecommunication System during construction phase in Rail\-based Transit System project(s)\*.
   

  

* Rail\-based Transit System project(s) shall mean High\-Speed Railways / Semi High\-Speed Railways / Metro Railways projects as defined below:
* High\-Speed Railways projects (ETCS based) with operational speed equal or greater than 250 Kmph shall only be considered for evaluation.
* Semi High\-Speed Railways including Urban/Suburban/ Intercity/ Regional Passenger Transit Systems, projects with operational speed equal to or greater than 160 Kmph shall only be considered for evaluation.
* Metro Railways excluding LRT/Tram/Monorail Systems, projects shall only be considered for evaluation.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!

description:
**Role Description**

This part\-time Freelance Senior Network Engineer / IT Consultant role is project\-based and on\-demand, which is mostly remote with some site\-survey requirements based in Delhi\-NCR region. You will design and implement network architectures, including routing, switching, and high\-density Wi\-Fi solutions for multi\-floor office environments. Day\-to\-day activities include assessing client requirements, performing site surveys, configuring and deploying network hardware and security appliances, and optimizing performance and reliability. You will also troubleshoot complex network issues, advise on cyber security and perimeter hardening, support GDPR\-compliant segmentation, and contribute to remote monitoring and management setups. Collaboration with national and international clients, internal teams, and external partners, as well as clear documentation and handover, are key parts of this role.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Network Engineering and Network Design, including experience with enterprise routing, switching, and Wi\-Fi architectures.
* Candidates should possess solid Network Administration skills, including configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of multi\-vendor environments (e.g., Cisco, Ubiquiti, Aruba, Fortinet).
* Candidates should possess advanced Network Security skills, covering firewalls, secure VPNs, segmentation, and security compliance\-focused designs.
* Candidates should possess excellent Troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving complex performance, connectivity, and security issues in live production networks.
* Relevant qualifications include Cisco CCNP or CCNA (or equivalent vendor certifications), proven experience in B2B or enterprise network projects, and familiarity with RMM tools and SLAs.
* Additional beneficial skills include strong consulting abilities, clear technical documentation, stakeholder communication in English, and the capacity to work independently on project\-based engagements.

**What We Offer**

* High scheduling flexibility that fits perfectly around your existing projects.
* Direct, hands\-on insights into real\-world IT rollouts—from the initial audit phase to live operational environments.
* Direct collaboration with the founder and plenty of room for your own ideas.
* Long\-term career growth opportunities with increasing project responsibility.

Interested in a flexible, high\-utility project based cooperation? Send us your CV along with a cover letter.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

* Can you briefly describe a past project where you designed and deployed a high\-density Wi\-Fi or multi\-level switching solution from scratch?

title: Network Engineer II
description:
**Details:**
 Job Description
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced L2 Network Engineer with strong expertise in enterprise networking, data\-center infrastructure, and Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI). The selected candidate will provide second\-level operational support for Cisco ACI fabrics, routers, switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, and related network\-management platforms.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for incident resolution, network monitoring, troubleshooting, approved configuration changes, maintenance activities, documentation, and collaboration with L1, L3, architecture, security, application, vendor, and globally distributed teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Cisco ACI and Data Center Networking
   

  

* Administer and troubleshoot Cisco ACI fabrics using Cisco APIC.
* Support and troubleshoot ACI tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, application profiles, contracts, filters, VLAN pools, AEPs, physical domains, and interface policies.
* Troubleshoot endpoint learning, endpoint attachment, EPG communication, contract enforcement, policy deployment, and fabric faults.
* Monitor and troubleshoot ACI fabric health scores, events, faults, interface issues, and node connectivity.
* Support Layer 2 and Layer 3 external connectivity, including L2Out and L3Out.
* Troubleshoot OSPF and BGP adjacency, route advertisement, redistribution, and reachability issues between ACI and external networks.
* Support ACI software upgrades, configuration backups, maintenance activities, validation, and rollback procedures.
* Participate in ACI implementation, migration, standardization, and network\-improvement projects.
* Provide operational support for ACI Multi\-Site or Multi\-Pod environments, where applicable.


 Enterprise Network Operations
   

  

* Provide L2 support for LAN, WAN, datacenter, internet\-edge, and wireless network incidents.
* Monitor, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco and Dell switches, routers, wireless controllers, and access points.
* Troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, including VLANs, trunking, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, inter\-VLAN routing, and device stacking.
* Troubleshoot routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP, based on the network design.
* Perform approved IOS, NX\-OS, firmware, and wireless\-controller upgrades.
* Perform hardware replacement, device commissioning, configuration restoration, and post\-change validation.
* Perform and validate network\-device configuration backups and restores using approved tools and procedures.
* Support remote installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of network devices using secure management methods.


 Firewall and Network Security
   

  

* Provide operational support for Cisco ASA/FTD and, where applicable, Palo Alto or Fortinet firewalls.
* Troubleshoot firewall zones, security rules, NAT, VPN, failover, and traffic\-flow issues.
* Support firewall changes in accordance with approved change\-management and security procedures.
* Support Cisco ISE authentication and authorization services, including RADIUS and TACACS\+ troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with security teams for firewall, access\-control, authentication, and policy\-related issues.


 Incident, Problem, and Change Management
   

  

* Resolve L2 incidents within agreed service levels and provide clear, timely technical updates.
* Perform structured troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for recurring or high\-impact incidents.
* Execute approved network changes and maintenance activities in accordance with change\-management procedures.
* Prepare implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, and post\-change reports.
* Escalate design\-level, high\-risk, or unresolved issues to L3 engineering, architecture, or vendor teams.
* Maintain accurate incident, problem, request, and change records in ServiceNow or an equivalent ITSM platform.
* Participate in major incident bridges and provide technical updates to stakeholders when required.


 Monitoring and Documentation
   

  

* Monitor network availability, utilization, capacity, performance, and fault conditions using Cisco Catalyst Center, SolarWinds, or equivalent tools.
* Review alerts, logs, events, health scores, and performance trends and take appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain network diagrams, configuration standards, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Prepare shift handovers, incident reports, post\-incident reviews, and operational documentation.
* Ensure that all activities comply with security, audit, access\-control, and change\-management requirements.


 Job Requirements
   

  

**Details:**
 Required Qualifications and Technical Skills
   

  

* 3\-7 years of experience in network engineering, network operations, data\-center networking, or infrastructure support.
* At least 2 years of hands\-on experience supporting Cisco ACI and APIC.
* Strong understanding of Cisco ACI architecture and its policy\-driven operating model.
* Hands\-on experience with tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, contracts, application profiles, L2Out, and L3Out.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4, subnetting, VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, and inter\-VLAN routing.
* Working experience with OSPF and BGP; EIGRP knowledge is advantageous.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting Cisco or equivalent switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, or Fortinet firewalls.
* Experience with network monitoring tools and ITSM platforms, preferably ServiceNow.
* Experience with network\-device configuration backup and restoration procedures.
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams and follow formal incident, problem, and change\-management processes.
* Bachelor"s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory where equivalent practical experience is demonstrated.


**Preferred Skills And Certifications**
* Cisco CCNA certification is preferred.
* Cisco CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Data Center is highly desirable.
* Experience with ACI Multi\-Site, Multi\-Pod, VMM integration, VMware networking, or hypervisor connectivity.
* Experience with Cisco ISE, Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco Prime, SolarWinds, or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud networking.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, or other network\-automation technologies.
* Experience creating and maintaining network diagrams using Microsoft Visio or equivalent tools.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong analytical and structured troubleshooting abilities.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong ownership of incidents through resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a service\-driven environment.
* Calm and professional approach during outages and critical incidents.
* Good customer service and stakeholder\-management orientation.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and support continuous improvement.
* Ability to work effectively during US time\-zone coverage, rotational shifts, and on\-call assignments.


 Working Conditions
   

  

* This position will be based in Noida or Hyderabad.
* US time\-zone support, rotational shifts, weekend maintenance, and occasional on\-call support may be required.
* The role may require coordination with global teams, customers, service providers, and technology vendors.
* The engineer must follow all company security, access\-control, confidentiality, and change management policies.
